2022-10-12.body: A +83% recovery as the Fed-cut path and stabilizing hardware demand lifted the group. The rally was milder than AI-levered peers, reflecting maturer end-markets and the 2024 inventory normalization.
2022-10-12.body_zh: 美联储降息路径和企稳的硬件需求提振该板块,回升+83%。涨幅较AI杠杆较高的同业温和,反映更成熟的终端市场和2024年的库存正常化。

2024-07-16.title: Carry-unwind air pocket
2024-07-16.body: A -18% dip during the August yen-carry unwind. Lower-beta non-AI tech held up better than the crowded AI trade.
2024-07-16.body_zh: 8月日元套息平仓期间下跌18%。低贝塔的非AI科技比拥挤的AI交易更抗跌。

2024-08-07.title: Modest cut-driven lift
2024-08-07.body: A +19% rise into February 2025 on the Fed's September cut and a firmer hardware cycle. Gains were restrained as the AI narrative siphoned leadership.
2024-08-07.body_zh: 美联储9月降息和更稳固的硬件周期推动,回升+19%至2025年2月。由于AI叙事吸走领导力,涨幅受限。

2025-02-20.title: DeepSeek & tariff slide
2025-02-20.body: A 31% drop through the DeepSeek scare and April's reciprocal-tariff crash. Hardware names with China exposure and consumer cyclicality were hit by tariff and demand fears.
2025-02-20.body_zh: 经历DeepSeek恐慌和4月对等关税崩盘,下跌31%。具中国敞口和消费周期性的硬件名字受关税和需求担忧打击。

2025-04-08.title: Broad tech melt-up sweep
2025-04-08.body: A +203% surge off the April low as the AI-capex melt-up, memory super-cycle and easing tariff fears lifted the entire tech complex. Networking silicon, analog/MCU and legacy hardware all benefited from spillover demand and a re-rating into the mid-2026 top.
2025-04-08.body_zh: AI资本开支飙升、内存超级周期和关税担忧消退提振整个科技板块,从4月低点飙升+203%。网络芯片、模拟/MCU和传统硬件都受益于外溢需求和估值重估,直至2026年中见顶。

non_ai_software.now: Trending but mid-pack on relative strength. Rate-sensitive enterprise SaaS lagged the AI leaders and just pulled back ~27% into late June as the post-Hormuz hawkish Fed bias re-pressured long-duration software multiples.
non_ai_software.now_zh: 处于上升趋势但相对强度居中。利率敏感的企业SaaS落后于AI龙头,6月底刚回调约27%,因霍尔木兹冲击后偏鹰的美联储再度压制长久期软件估值。

2021-11-09.title: Duration-software de-rating
2021-11-09.body: Non-AI software fell 47% as the Fed pivot hammered the longest-duration, profitless-growth SaaS names. Rising discount rates and a hard valuation reset hit the high-multiple software complex.
2021-11-09.body_zh: 美联储转向重击久期最长、尚未盈利的成长型SaaS名字,非AI软件下跌47%。贴现率上升和硬性估值重置冲击高估值软件板块。

2022-03-14.title: Brief oversold bounce
2022-03-14.body: A +32% bounce off oversold conditions as rate volatility briefly eased. The relief faded fast with the hiking cycle still accelerating.
2022-03-14.body_zh: 利率波动短暂缓和,从超卖状态反弹+32%。加息周期仍在加速,缓解迅速消退。

2022-04-04.title: Rate-driven new lows
2022-04-04.body: A 38% slide to mid-June lows as real yields surged and software multiples kept compressing. Slowing software-spend guidance compounded the macro pressure.
2022-04-04.body_zh: 实际收益率飙升、软件估值持续压缩,下滑38%至6月中旬低点。软件支出指引放缓加剧了宏观压力。

2022-06-16.title: Peak-inflation relief rally
2022-06-16.body: A +41% rally on peak-inflation hopes and a yield pullback. The bounce was a duration-sensitivity reflex, not a fundamental inflection.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 受通胀见顶预期和收益率回落提振,反弹+41%。此弹升是久期敏感性的反射,而非基本面拐点。

2022-08-10.title: Hawkish reset leg down
2022-08-10.body: A 37% drop into November as Jackson Hole and persistent inflation pushed yields higher. Profitless software bore the brunt of the renewed de-rating.
2022-08-10.body_zh: 杰克逊霍尔和顽固通胀推高收益率,跌至11月,下挫37%。未盈利软件承受了新一轮估值下杀的主要冲击。

2022-11-09.title: Disinflation re-rating rally
2022-11-09.body: A +114% recovery as cooling CPI and the eventual 2024 Fed cuts revived risk appetite. Margin-improvement stories and durable subscription revenue rebuilt the bid through early 2024.
2022-11-09.body_zh: CPI降温和最终2024年的美联储降息重燃风险偏好,回升+114%。利润率改善故事和稳健的订阅收入在2024年初前重建买盘。

2024-02-09.title: Capex-anxiety pullback
2024-02-09.body: A -27% pullback as AI-capex fears questioned whether software budgets would be diverted to compute. Soft net-retention prints and the yen-carry unwind added pressure.
2024-02-09.body_zh: AI资本开支担忧引发软件预算是否被算力挤占的质疑,回调27%。疲软的净留存数据和日元套息平仓增添压力。

2024-08-05.title: Cut-cycle software rebound
2024-08-05.body: A +56% recovery as the Fed's September cut lifted rate-sensitive software. Improving budgets and a soft-landing narrative carried the group into December 2024.
2024-08-05.body_zh: 美联储9月降息提振利率敏感的软件,回升+56%。改善的预算和软着陆叙事推动该板块至2024年12月。

2024-12-06.title: DeepSeek & tariff drawdown
2024-12-06.body: A 34% drop through the DeepSeek scare and April's reciprocal-tariff crash. Macro de-risking and AI-disruption fears for legacy SaaS drove the de-rating.
2024-12-06.body_zh: 经历DeepSeek恐慌和4月对等关税崩盘,下跌34%。宏观去风险和传统SaaS被AI颠覆的担忧驱动估值下杀。

2025-04-08.title: Post-tariff relief rally
2025-04-08.body: A +32% bounce off the April low as tariff fears eased and rate expectations stabilized. Gains lagged the AI leaders as software still faced an AI-disruption overhang.
2025-04-08.body_zh: 关税担忧消退、利率预期企稳,从4月低点反弹+32%。由于软件仍面临AI颠覆阴影,涨幅落后于AI龙头。

2025-07-28.title: Hawkish-reset duration drag
2025-07-28.body: A 47% slide as the late-2025 hawkish reset and the early-2026 Hormuz oil shock (CPI 4.2%) lifted yields and crushed long-duration software. Persistent AI-cannibalization fears deepened the de-rating into April 2026.
2025-07-28.body_zh: 2025年末鹰派重置和2026年初霍尔木兹石油冲击(CPI 4.2%)推高收益率,重创长久期软件,下滑47%。持续的AI蚕食担忧加深了至2026年4月的估值下杀。

2026-04-10.title: Ceasefire-relief recovery
2026-04-10.body: A +54% recovery as the mid-June Hormuz ceasefire eased the oil/inflation shock and yields backed off. Oversold software re-rated as macro fear faded and budgets stabilized.
2026-04-10.body_zh: 6月中旬霍尔木兹停火缓和石油/通胀冲击、收益率回落,回升+54%。宏观恐慌消退、预算企稳,超卖的软件估值重估。

2026-06-01.title: Hawkish-bias June pullback
2026-06-01.body: A -27% pullback as the post-ceasefire Fed retained a hiking bias and tech leadership narrowed. Rate-sensitive software gave back gains alongside the broad late-cycle de-risking.
2026-06-01.body_zh: 停火后美联储维持加息倾向、科技领导力收窄,回调27%。利率敏感的软件随着广泛的周期末去风险一同回吐涨幅。

cybersecurity.now: Topping at the 87th percentile. Cyber (CRWD/PANW/ZS) compounded on secular spend and breach catalysts, but a stretched 2026 rally and the broad tech-leadership rollover argue for consolidation.
cybersecurity.now_zh: 在87百分位见顶。网络安全(CRWD/PANW/ZS)受益于长期支出和数据泄露催化而复利增长,但2026年过度拉伸的涨势和广泛的科技领导力回落指向盘整。

2021-11-09.title: Growth-multiple compression
2021-11-09.body: Cyber fell 36% as the Fed pivot de-rated high-multiple security-software growth names. Rising rates outweighed strong secular bookings in the broad SaaS sell-off.
2021-11-09.body_zh: 美联储转向令高估值的安全软件成长股估值下杀,网络安全下跌36%。在广泛的SaaS抛售中,利率上升盖过了强劲的长期订单。

2022-03-14.title: Oversold relief bounce
2022-03-14.body: A +28% bounce as rate volatility briefly cooled. The geopolitical backdrop kept a structural cyber-spend bid even as macro pressure lingered.
2022-03-14.body_zh: 利率波动短暂降温,反弹+28%。即便宏观压力犹存,地缘政治背景维持了结构性的网络安全支出买盘。

2022-04-04.title: Rate-shock new lows
2022-04-04.body: A 36% slide as surging real yields hit growth software again. Budget-scrutiny worries layered onto the macro de-rating.
2022-04-04.body_zh: 实际收益率飙升再度冲击成长软件,下滑36%。预算审视担忧叠加于宏观估值下杀之上。

2022-05-11.title: Peak-inflation rally
2022-05-11.body: A +33% rebound on peak-inflation hopes and a yield reprieve. Resilient security budgets supported the bounce relative to broader software.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 受通胀见顶预期和收益率回落提振,反弹+33%。有韧性的安全预算使其反弹强于大盘软件。

2022-08-15.title: Hawkish leg down
2022-08-15.body: A 30% drop into January 2023 as Jackson Hole pushed yields higher. Lengthening sales cycles and macro caution pressured the group.
2022-08-15.body_zh: 杰克逊霍尔推高收益率,跌至2023年1月,下挫30%。拉长的销售周期和宏观谨慎压制该板块。

2023-01-05.title: Secular-spend compounding
2023-01-05.body: A +136% run as disinflation, the genAI rally and relentless secular security demand compounded. Breach catalysts and platform-consolidation wins at CrowdStrike and Palo Alto sustained the bid through the 2024 cut cycle.
2023-01-05.body_zh: 去通胀、生成式AI上涨和不断增长的长期安全需求叠加,上涨+136%。数据泄露催化和CrowdStrike、Palo Alto的平台整合胜利,在2024年降息周期前维持买盘。

2025-02-13.title: DeepSeek & tariff dip
2025-02-13.body: A -23% pullback through the DeepSeek scare and April's reciprocal-tariff crash. Macro de-risking hit growth software despite resilient cyber fundamentals.
2025-02-13.body_zh: 经历DeepSeek恐慌和4月对等关税崩盘,回调23%。尽管网络安全基本面稳健,宏观去风险仍冲击成长软件。

2025-04-08.title: Recovery on breach catalysts
2025-04-08.body: A +44% recovery off the April low as tariff fears eased and high-profile breaches reinforced the spend case. AI-security and identity demand kept the group bid into November.
2025-04-08.body_zh: 关税担忧消退、备受关注的数据泄露强化支出逻辑,从4月低点回升+44%。AI安全和身份认证需求维持该板块买盘至11月。

2025-11-11.title: Hawkish-reset consolidation
2025-11-11.body: A 29% drop as the late-2025 hawkish reset and the early-2026 Hormuz oil/CPI shock pressured growth multiples. Stretched valuations made cyber vulnerable to the broad de-risking.
2025-11-11.body_zh: 2025年末鹰派重置和2026年初霍尔木兹石油/CPI冲击压制成长估值,下跌29%。过高的估值使网络安全易受广泛去风险影响。

2026-02-23.title: Ceasefire-relief rally to top
2026-02-23.body: A +64% rally as the mid-June Hormuz ceasefire eased macro fear and durable security spend reasserted leadership. The group ran to topping levels before the broad tech-leadership rollover began.
2026-02-23.body_zh: 6月中旬霍尔木兹停火缓和宏观恐慌、稳健的安全支出重申领导力,反弹+64%。在广泛的科技领导力回落开始前,该板块涨至见顶水平。

quantum_computing.now: Trending with strong relative strength but speculative by nature. With only two long legs of history, quantum is a high-beta, retail-driven theme prone to violent spikes — riding the 2023-25 AI-adjacency narrative.
quantum_computing.now_zh: 处于上升趋势且相对强度强,但本质投机。仅有两条长腿的历史,量子计算是高贝塔、散户驱动的主题,易发生剧烈飙升——搭乘2023-25年的AI邻接叙事。

2021-11-17.title: SPAC-era speculative washout
2021-11-17.body: Quantum names fell 61% over 15 months as the Fed-hiking bear crushed profitless, pre-revenue speculative tech. The de-SPAC cohort, with no near-term commercialization, saw the deepest multiple compression of the rate shock.
2021-11-17.body_zh: 美联储加息熊市重创未盈利、零营收的投机科技,量子计算股15个月内下跌61%。无近期商业化的de-SPAC群体,在利率冲击中遭遇最深的估值压缩。

2023-03-15.title: AI-adjacency moonshot rally
2023-03-15.body: An explosive +1,773% run as the genAI boom, falling rates and headline milestones (Google/IBM/Nvidia quantum signals) drew retail into the highest-beta frontier-tech theme. The move was narrative- and momentum-driven — violent, retail-led and largely detached from near-term revenue, peaking in October 2025.
2023-03-15.body_zh: 生成式AI热潮、利率下行和标志性里程碑(谷歌/IBM/英伟达的量子信号)将散户引入贝塔最高的前沿科技主题,爆发性上涨+1,773%。此波由叙事和动能驱动——剧烈、散户主导且基本脱离近期营收,在2025年10月见顶。

data_center_power.now: Power & cooling kit for AI datacenters (GE Vernova, Vertiv, Eaton) — the electricity super-cycle re-rated this group from late 2023 as AI compute exploded demand for generation, transformers and thermal management. After a 287% run off the April-2025 tariff low, the basket is rolling over as the AI-capex pace gets re-examined.
data_center_power.now_zh: 为AI数据中心供电与散热的设备龙头（GE Vernova、Vertiv、Eaton）——电力超级周期自2023年底起重估这一组别，因AI算力激增推高了发电、变压器与热管理需求。在4月关税低点后上涨287%之后，随着市场重新审视AI资本开支节奏，该篮子正在见顶回落。

2021-11-08.title: Fed pivot hawkish, growth de-rates
2021-11-08.body: Power-infrastructure names sold off with the broad 2022 bear as the Fed pivoted to aggressive hiking and long-duration capex stories de-rated. This pre-dated the AI-power thesis, so the group traded as ordinary industrial/utility cyclicals on rising discount rates.
2021-11-08.title_zh: 美联储转鹰，成长股估值下杀
2021-11-08.body_zh: 电力基础设施类股随2022年大熊市下跌，原因是美联储转向激进加息、长久期资本开支题材遭估值压缩。此时尚无AI电力主线，该组别只是按普通工业／公用事业周期股、随贴现率上行而走弱。

2022-07-01.title: AI electricity super-cycle re-rates group
2022-07-01.body: From the 2022 low this basket compounded +319% as the AI-datacenter electricity thesis took hold through 2023-24 — power, transformers, switchgear and liquid cooling became the bottleneck on the AI buildout. Vertiv, GE Vernova and Eaton re-rated from sleepy industrials into AI-power core holdings.
2022-07-01.title_zh: AI电力超级周期重估该组别
2022-07-01.body_zh: 自2022年低点起，该篮子累计上涨319%，因AI数据中心电力主线在2023–24年确立——电力、变压器、开关设备与液冷成为AI建设的瓶颈环节。Vertiv、GE Vernova与Eaton从沉闷的工业股重估为AI电力核心持仓。

2024-05-24.title: Summer rate-jitters profit-take
2024-05-24.body: A shallow pullback as megacap-tech and AI-adjacent names wobbled into the August 2024 volatility scare and the yen-carry unwind. The power thesis stayed intact; this was froth coming off an extended group rather than a thesis break.
2024-05-24.title_zh: 夏季利率波动引发获利了结
2024-05-24.body_zh: 在2024年8月波动惊魂与日元套利平仓前，巨型科技与AI相关股震荡，带来一次浅幅回调。电力主线依旧完好，这只是涨幅过大组别的泡沫挤出，并非逻辑破裂。

2024-08-07.title: Fed cuts + AI power demand surge
2024-08-07.body: A +60% leg as the Fed began cutting in September 2024 and a wave of hyperscaler capex guidance plus nuclear/grid power deals validated the AI electricity demand story. Datacenter power-purchase agreements and surging load forecasts kept the bid firm.
2024-08-07.title_zh: 美联储降息＋AI电力需求激增
2024-08-07.body_zh: 上涨60%，因美联储于2024年9月开始降息，叠加超大规模厂商资本开支指引与核电／电网供电协议接连落地，验证了AI电力需求逻辑。数据中心购电协议与飙升的负荷预测使买盘稳固。

2025-01-22.title: DeepSeek questions AI power demand
2025-01-22.body: A 37% drawdown triggered late January 2025 by DeepSeek's efficiency shock, which briefly questioned whether AI would need as much electricity, then deepened into the April tariff crash. The most directly power-levered names were hit hardest on the demand-destruction fear.
2025-01-22.body_zh: 2025年1月底由DeepSeek效率冲击触发的37%回撤，市场一度质疑AI是否仍需如此大量电力，随后在4月关税崩盘中进一步加深。需求毁灭担忧下，电力杠杆最直接的标的跌幅最大。

2025-04-04.title: Tariff-low recovery, super-cycle reasserts
2025-04-04.body: A +287% recovery off the early-April 2025 tariff low as the DeepSeek scare faded and hyperscaler capex re-accelerated — power, cooling and grid kit reclaimed AI-leadership status. The group ran hard into mid-2026 before rolling over as the AI-capex pace was re-examined.
2025-04-04.title_zh: 关税低点反弹，超级周期重启
2025-04-04.body_zh: 自2025年4月初关税低点上涨287%，DeepSeek惊魂消退、超大厂商资本开支重新加速——电力、散热与电网设备重夺AI领涨地位。该组别一路猛涨至2026年中，随后因AI资本开支节奏被重新审视而见顶回落。

nuclear_power.now: Nuclear utilities + SMR developers (Constellation, Vistra, Oklo, SMR) — the highest-beta way to play AI baseload power demand, reactor restarts and new-build optionality. After a ~205% surge into October 2025 the group corrected hard; now in prime-entry territory after a fresh leg lower into mid-2026.
nuclear_power.now_zh: 核电公用事业＋小型模块化反应堆(SMR)开发商（Constellation、Vistra、Oklo、SMR）——押注AI基荷电力需求、反应堆重启与新建产能期权的最高弹性方式。在2025年10月飙升约205%后大幅回调；经2026年中又一轮下跌后，目前处于优选入场区间。

2024-07-12.title: Summer vol scare clips leaders
2024-07-12.body: A sharp 26% pullback into the August 2024 volatility spike and carry unwind, as the newly hot nuclear-for-AI names gave back froth. The restart/baseload thesis was intact — this was positioning, not a fundamental break.
2024-07-12.title_zh: 夏季波动惊魂回吐涨幅
2024-07-12.body_zh: 在2024年8月波动飙升与套利平仓前急跌26%，新晋火热的核电AI概念股吐出泡沫。重启／基荷逻辑完好——此为仓位调整，而非基本面破裂。

2024-08-05.title: Datacenter nuclear deals ignite re-rate
2024-08-05.body: A +202% rocket leg as marquee datacenter-nuclear deals — Constellation's Three Mile Island restart for Microsoft, Amazon/Google SMR commitments — validated nuclear as the AI baseload answer. Fed cuts and reactor-restart headlines compounded the buying frenzy.
2024-08-05.title_zh: 数据中心核电协议点燃重估
2024-08-05.body_zh: 上涨202%的火箭行情，标志性数据中心核电协议——Constellation为微软重启三哩岛、亚马逊／谷歌的SMR承诺——确立核电为AI基荷答案。美联储降息与反应堆重启新闻叠加放大买盘狂热。

2025-01-24.title: DeepSeek demand-shock flush
2025-01-24.body: A two-session 22% flush as DeepSeek's efficiency claims hit late January 2025, hammering the AI-power-demand premium hardest in the high-beta nuclear/SMR cohort. Pre-revenue SMR developers were the most exposed to the demand-destruction narrative.
2025-01-24.body_zh: 两个交易日内急挫22%，2025年1月底DeepSeek效率说法冲击AI电力需求溢价，对高弹性核电／SMR组别打击最重。尚无营收的SMR开发商最受需求毁灭叙事拖累。

2025-01-27.title: Snap-back bargain bid
2025-01-27.body: A quick +22% bounce as dip-buyers concluded the DeepSeek demand-destruction read was overdone — efficiency gains arguably expand AI deployment and total power draw. Volatile, headline-driven trading in a thin pure-play group.
2025-01-27.body_zh: 迅速反弹22%，抄底资金认为DeepSeek需求毁灭解读过度——效率提升反而可能扩大AI部署与总用电量。这是薄盘纯概念组别中受新闻驱动的剧烈波动。

2025-02-10.title: Pre-tariff risk-off de-rate
2025-02-10.body: A 34% slide as the broad risk-off into the spring 2025 tariff scare drained the speculative premium from high-multiple nuclear/SMR names. Rate-sensitive utilities and pre-revenue developers both leaked into the April low.
2025-02-10.title_zh: 关税前避险情绪压估值
2025-02-10.body_zh: 下跌34%，2025年春关税惊魂前的广泛避险抽走了高估值核电／SMR标的的投机溢价。利率敏感的公用事业与尚无营收的开发商均在4月低点前承压。

2025-03-10.title: Relief rally on policy hopes
2025-03-10.body: A +24% bounce on nuclear-friendly policy signals and bargain-hunting before the final pre-tariff leg lower. Choppy, two-way trade as the market struggled to price the tariff overhang against a still-intact AI-baseload story.
2025-03-10.body_zh: 反弹24%，受利好核电的政策信号与逢低买盘推动，随后在关税前最后一轮下跌。市场在关税阴影与依旧完好的AI基荷逻辑之间反复定价，呈双向震荡。

2025-03-24.title: Final pre-tariff washout
2025-03-24.body: A 26% drop into the early-April 2025 tariff-crash low, completing the deep correction from the January 2025 peak. The high-beta nuclear group capitulated alongside the broad AI complex before the recovery began.
2025-03-24.body_zh: 下跌26%至2025年4月初关税崩盘低点，完成自2025年1月高点的深度回调。高弹性核电组别随整个AI板块投降性抛售，随后反弹启动。

2025-04-04.title: Tariff-low moonshot resumes
2025-04-04.body: A +205% surge off the April-2025 tariff low as AI-power demand reasserted, hyperscaler capex re-accelerated and the reactor-restart/SMR newsflow returned. The group ran to a fresh peak by mid-October 2025 on relentless AI-baseload buying.
2025-04-04.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点飙升205%，AI电力需求重新确立、超大厂商资本开支再加速、反应堆重启／SMR新闻流回归。在持续的AI基荷买盘下，该组别于2025年10月中创出新高。

2025-10-15.title: Overextended group corrects 39%
2025-10-15.body: A 39% drawdown from the October-2025 blow-off top as the most stretched AI-power trade unwound — rising rates, AI-capex digestion fears and froth in pre-revenue SMR names drove the de-rate. The fundamental restart thesis stayed intact through the price reset.
2025-10-15.body_zh: 自2025年10月喷发顶部回撤39%，最被拉伸的AI电力交易平仓——利率上行、AI资本开支消化担忧与尚无营收SMR标的的泡沫推动估值下杀。价格重置过程中，重启基本面逻辑依旧完好。

2026-03-30.title: Oversold bounce on restart wins
2026-03-30.body: A +30% recovery as bargain-hunting met fresh reactor-restart and SMR-licensing milestones in early 2026. House view: a relief rally within a still-volatile group rather than a confirmed new uptrend.
2026-03-30.title_zh: 重启利好带动超跌反弹
2026-03-30.body_zh: 反弹30%，2026年初逢低买盘遇上新的反应堆重启与SMR许可里程碑。本观点：这是仍然波动的组别内的修复性反弹，而非确认的新上升趋势。

2026-05-06.title: Pulls back into prime entry
2026-05-06.body: A 22% give-back into mid-June 2026, leaving the basket deeply washed out and screening as prime-entry on our framework. House view: positioning is light and the AI-baseload thesis is durable, but confirmation of a trend turn is still pending.
2026-05-06.body_zh: 至2026年6月中回吐22%，使篮子深度超跌，在我们框架中显示为优选入场。本观点：仓位轻、AI基荷逻辑持久，但趋势反转的确认仍待出现。

power_grid.now: Grid & transmission buildout — transformers, switchgear, utility-adjacent capex riding the same AI-load + electrification wave. The group ran ~249% off the 2022 low but now sits in bottoming territory after a 2025-26 consolidation; positioning is washed out while the multi-year grid-capex story stays intact.
power_grid.now_zh: 电网与输配电建设——变压器、开关设备、公用事业相关资本开支，搭乘同一波AI负荷＋电气化浪潮。该组别自2022年低点上涨约249%，但经2025–26年盘整后目前处于筑底区间；仓位已超跌，而多年期电网资本开支逻辑依旧完好。

2022-09-12.title: Late-2022 bear-market low
2022-09-12.body: A 15% slide into the October 2022 cycle low as peak-hawkish Fed pricing and recession fear hit rate-sensitive utilities and capital-goods names. Grid/electrification was not yet a market theme — this traded as ordinary defensive-cyclical weakness.
2022-09-12.body_zh: 下跌15%至2022年10月周期低点，美联储鹰派定价见顶与衰退担忧打击利率敏感的公用事业与资本品标的。电网／电气化尚未成为市场主线——此为普通的防御周期股走弱。

2022-10-14.title: Grid-capex super-cycle re-rate
2022-10-14.body: A +249% multi-year run as the AI-datacenter load surge, electrification and aging-grid replacement turned transmission and transformer suppliers into a structural-growth story through 2023-24. Power-grid capex went from defensive to one of the market's best secular themes.
2022-10-14.title_zh: 电网资本开支超级周期重估
2022-10-14.body_zh: 多年期上涨249%，AI数据中心负荷激增、电气化与老化电网更换，使输配电与变压器供应商在2023–24年成为结构性成长故事。电网资本开支从防御性变为市场最佳长期主线之一。

2025-01-24.title: DeepSeek + tariff de-rate
2025-01-24.body: A 29% correction triggered by DeepSeek's late-January 2025 efficiency shock — which questioned AI power demand — and deepened by the April tariff crash. Grid names sold off on demand-doubt even though their order books reflected multi-year backlogs.
2025-01-24.body_zh: 回调29%，由DeepSeek 2025年1月底效率冲击（质疑AI电力需求）触发，并在4月关税崩盘中加深。尽管订单簿反映多年积压，电网股仍因需求疑虑而下跌。

2025-04-04.title: Tariff-low recovery rally
2025-04-04.body: A +115% recovery off the April-2025 tariff low as AI-load forecasts and grid-interconnection backlogs reasserted the structural bid. Utility capex guidance and transformer-supply tightness kept the bid firm through October 2025.
2025-04-04.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点上涨115%，AI负荷预测与电网并网积压重新确立结构性买盘。公用事业资本开支指引与变压器供应紧张使买盘稳固至2025年10月。

2025-10-29.title: Autumn AI-capex digestion dip
2025-10-29.body: A 17% pullback as the broad AI-capex complex digested its run into late 2025 and rates ticked higher. A garden-variety consolidation in an extended group rather than a thesis break.
2025-10-29.title_zh: 秋季AI资本开支消化回调
2025-10-29.body_zh: 回调17%，整个AI资本开支板块在2025年底消化涨幅、利率小幅上行。这是涨幅过大组别的常规盘整，而非逻辑破裂。

2025-12-17.title: Grinds back, now bottoming
2025-12-17.body: A +36% recovery into May 2026 that nonetheless leaves the group screening as bottoming with low positioning after the choppy 2025-26 range. House view: the multi-year grid/transmission-capex backlog is durable; a fresh trending breakout is still unconfirmed.
2025-12-17.body_zh: 至2026年5月回升36%，但经2025–26年震荡区间后，该组别仍显示为筑底、仓位偏低。本观点：多年期电网／输配电资本开支积压持久；新的趋势突破仍未确认。

energy_complex.now: Broad US oil & gas — integrateds, E&P, services and midstream that track crude (XLE). The basket round-tripped the 2022 Russia spike and 2025 tariff crash, spiked again on the 2026 Iran/Strait-of-Hormuz oil shock, then rolled over as the mid-June 2026 ceasefire unwound the war premium.
energy_complex.now_zh: 广义美国油气——综合油企、勘探开采、油服与中游，跟随原油走势(XLE)。该篮子经历了2022年俄乌飙升与2025年关税崩盘的往返，又在2026年伊朗／霍尔木兹海峡石油冲击中再度飙升，随后随2026年6月中停火、战争溢价消退而见顶回落。

2020-10-28.title: Post-COVID + Russia crude super-spike
2020-10-28.body: A +331% rocket from the 2020 COVID trough through June 2022, as reopening demand collided with OPEC+ discipline and Russia's February 2022 invasion of Ukraine sent crude toward ~$120. Energy was the best-performing sector as the rest of the market fell into a bear.
2020-10-28.title_zh: 后疫情＋俄乌原油超级飙升
2020-10-28.body_zh: 自2020年疫情谷底至2022年6月火箭式上涨331%，复工需求碰上OPEC+限产，叠加2022年2月俄罗斯入侵乌克兰将原油推向约120美元。在大盘陷入熊市之际，能源是表现最佳的板块。

2022-06-07.title: Recession-fear crude pullback
2022-06-07.body: A 27% drop as demand-destruction and recession fear from aggressive Fed hiking pulled crude sharply off its June 2022 peak. The fastest leg of the broad commodity de-rate as growth expectations rolled over.
2022-06-07.title_zh: 衰退担忧引发原油回调
2022-06-07.body_zh: 下跌27%，美联储激进加息带来的需求毁灭与衰退担忧，使原油从2022年6月峰值急挫。在增长预期回落之际，这是广义大宗商品估值下杀中最快的一段。

2022-07-14.title: Range-bound grind, capital discipline
2022-07-14.body: A +78% grind into late November 2024 as crude chopped in a wide range while disciplined buybacks, dividends and strong free cash flow rewarded integrateds and E&P. A slow, fundamentals-driven climb rather than a crude-price moonshot.
2022-07-14.body_zh: 至2024年11月底缓步上涨78%，原油宽幅震荡，而有纪律的回购、分红与强劲自由现金流回报综合油企与勘探开采商。这是缓慢的基本面驱动攀升，而非油价暴涨。

2024-11-22.title: Tariff-crash + oversupply de-rate
2024-11-22.body: A 23% slide into the early-April 2025 tariff crash as global-growth fear and OPEC+ supply-add plans pressured crude. Energy underperformed badly as recession-demand worries layered onto a softening oil balance.
2024-11-22.title_zh: 关税崩盘＋供给过剩压估值
2024-11-22.body_zh: 下跌23%至2025年4月初关税崩盘，全球增长担忧与OPEC+增产计划压制原油。在衰退需求担忧叠加趋松的油市平衡之际，能源大幅跑输。

2025-04-08.title: Iran/Hormuz oil-shock spike
2025-04-08.body: A +81% recovery off the tariff low, powered by the 2026 Iran/Strait-of-Hormuz crisis that spiked crude toward ~$120 and pushed CPI to 4.2% (house view). The war premium peaked into mid-May 2026 before the ceasefire; integrateds and E&P led on the supply-disruption bid.
2025-04-08.title_zh: 伊朗／霍尔木兹石油冲击飙升
2025-04-08.body_zh: 自关税低点反弹81%，由2026年伊朗／霍尔木兹海峡危机驱动，将原油推向约120美元、CPI升至4.2%（本观点）。战争溢价于2026年5月中、停火前见顶；供应中断买盘下综合油企与勘探开采领涨。

uranium_miners.now: Uranium miners + fuel cycle (Cameco, Sprott physical) — the high-beta, supply-driven fuel side of the nuclear revival, geared to uranium spot price and reactor restarts. After a ~292% run into October 2025 the group sold off hard; it now sits deeply washed out in bottoming territory amid a 2026 spot-price consolidation.
uranium_miners.now_zh: 铀矿商＋燃料循环（Cameco、Sprott实物）——核电复兴中高弹性、供给驱动的燃料侧，紧贴铀现货价格与反应堆重启。在2025年10月飙升约292%后大幅下跌；目前在2026年现货价盘整中深度超跌、处于筑底区间。

2021-11-08.title: Sprott-squeeze froth unwinds
2021-11-08.body: A 45% drop into late January 2022 as the 2021 Sprott Physical Trust-driven spot squeeze faded and the broad risk-off into Fed hiking hit speculative miners. Pure spot/supply dynamics, ahead of the AI-power demand era.
2021-11-08.body_zh: 下跌45%至2022年1月底，2021年由Sprott实物信托驱动的现货逼空消退，叠加美联储加息前的广泛避险打击投机性矿商。纯现货／供给动态，早于AI电力需求时代。

2022-01-27.title: Russia-supply-fear spot bid
2022-01-27.body: A +66% spike as Russia's invasion of Ukraine raised fears over Russian enrichment and conversion supply, lifting uranium spot and the high-beta miners. A geopolitics-on-supply leg, characteristic of this group.
2022-01-27.title_zh: 俄罗斯供应担忧推升现货
2022-01-27.body_zh: 飙升66%，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰引发对俄铀浓缩与转化供应的担忧，推高铀现货与高弹性矿商。这是地缘政治冲击供给的一段，为该组别的典型特征。

2022-04-13.title: Hawkish-Fed risk-off flush
2022-04-13.body: A 44% flush as peak-hawkish Fed pricing and a broad commodity/risk-asset de-rate hit the volatile miners. High-beta uranium gave back the geopolitical spike on macro de-risking.
2022-04-13.body_zh: 急挫44%，美联储鹰派定价见顶与广义大宗商品／风险资产估值下杀打击波动剧烈的矿商。在宏观去风险下，高弹性铀股回吐地缘政治飙升。

2022-05-12.title: Supply-deficit thesis re-bids
2022-05-12.body: A +52% bounce as the structural supply-deficit story — underinvested mines versus reactor restarts and life-extensions — drew buyers back. Spot uranium firmed on utility contracting and term-market activity.
2022-05-12.title_zh: 供给短缺逻辑重获买盘
2022-05-12.body_zh: 反弹52%，结构性供给短缺故事——投资不足的矿山对比反应堆重启与延寿——吸引买盘回归。公用事业签约与长协市场活跃使铀现货走强。

2022-09-09.title: Recession-demand de-rate
2022-09-09.body: A 41% drawdown into May 2023 as global recession fear and the broad 2022-23 risk-asset de-rate weighed on the cyclical miners. Spot uranium consolidated despite the durable long-term deficit narrative.
2022-09-09.body_zh: 回撤41%至2023年5月，全球衰退担忧与2022–23年广义风险资产估值下杀拖累周期性矿商。尽管长期短缺叙事持久，铀现货仍盘整。

2023-05-30.title: Spot breakout to $100 run
2023-05-30.body: A +164% surge into May 2024 as uranium spot broke out toward $100/lb on supply tightness, Kazatomprom production warnings, Sprott physical buying and the dawning AI-power/reactor-restart narrative. The group's biggest clean trend in years.
2023-05-30.body_zh: 至2024年5月飙升164%，铀现货因供应紧张、Kazatomprom减产预警、Sprott实物买入与初现的AI电力／反应堆重启叙事而突破奔向每磅100美元。这是该组别多年来最干净的趋势。

2024-05-20.title: Spot rolls over, summer flush
2024-05-20.body: A 38% drop into September 2024 as uranium spot retreated from the $100 high on thin-volume term-market softness and the August 2024 volatility scare. The high-beta miners overshot the spot pullback.
2024-05-20.body_zh: 下跌38%至2024年9月，铀现货因长协市场成交清淡转弱与2024年8月波动惊魂从100美元高位回落。高弹性矿商超调于现货回调。

2024-09-06.title: Restart headlines re-ignite bid
2024-09-06.body: A +82% rocket as datacenter-nuclear deals (Three Mile Island restart) and Fed cuts re-ignited the nuclear-fuel bid. Uranium miners were pulled up with the reactor-restart wave into late November 2024.
2024-09-06.body_zh: 火箭式上涨82%，数据中心核电协议（三哩岛重启）与美联储降息重燃核燃料买盘。铀矿商随反应堆重启浪潮被推升至2024年11月底。

2024-11-22.title: DeepSeek + tariff deep de-rate
2024-11-22.body: A 49% drawdown into the April-2025 tariff low, hit first by DeepSeek's late-January AI-power-demand shock and then the tariff crash. The high-beta miners led the AI-nuclear complex lower on demand-doubt and broad risk-off.
2024-11-22.body_zh: 回撤49%至2025年4月关税低点，先受DeepSeek 1月底AI电力需求冲击，再遭关税崩盘。在需求疑虑与广泛避险下，高弹性矿商领跌整个AI核电板块。

2025-04-08.title: Tariff-low to spot moonshot
2025-04-08.body: A +292% surge off the April-2025 tariff low as uranium spot broke higher on reactor restarts, government nuclear support and supply-deficit buying, while the AI-baseload story re-accelerated. The high-beta miners delivered the group's largest run into October 2025.
2025-04-08.body_zh: 自2025年4月关税低点飙升292%，铀现货因反应堆重启、政府核能支持与供给短缺买盘而上行，AI基荷故事同步再加速。高弹性矿商交出该组别至2025年10月的最大一波涨幅。

2025-10-15.title: Blow-off top, 36% reset
2025-10-15.body: A 36% pullback from the October-2025 spot/equity peak as the most stretched fuel-cycle trade unwound on profit-taking and a spot-price stall. A froth purge in a high-beta group, not a break of the supply-deficit thesis.
2025-10-15.body_zh: 自2025年10月现货／股价峰值回调36%，最被拉伸的燃料循环交易因获利了结与现货价停滞而平仓。这是高弹性组别的泡沫挤出，而非供给短缺逻辑破裂。

2025-11-21.title: Restart-driven relief bounce
2025-11-21.body: A +71% rebound into late January 2026 on renewed reactor-restart and utility-contracting headlines that firmed uranium spot. Volatile, headline-sensitive trade characteristic of the high-beta miners.
2025-11-21.body_zh: 至2026年1月底反弹71%，新一轮反应堆重启与公用事业签约新闻使铀现货走强。这是高弹性矿商典型的、对新闻敏感的剧烈交易。

2026-01-28.title: Spot consolidates, deep washout
2026-01-28.body: A 42% slide into mid-June 2026 as uranium spot consolidated and the high-beta miners de-rated, leaving the group deeply washed out in bottoming territory. House view: the multi-year supply-deficit and restart thesis is durable, but a confirmed spot-price turn is still pending.
2026-01-28.body_zh: 下跌42%至2026年6月中，铀现货盘整、高弹性矿商估值下杀，使该组别深度超跌、处于筑底区间。本观点：多年期供给短缺与重启逻辑持久，但现货价反转的确认仍待出现。

defense.now: Defense & Aerospace (RTX/LMT/GD/Boeing, ITA proxy) sits in the doghouse despite a world that looks built for it. Two hot wars — Russia-Ukraine grinding into its fourth year and a Mideast that flared into the June 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock before a mid-month ceasefire — plus NATO rearmament should be a tailwind. Yet the basket is the dashboard's #32 relative-strength rank and tagged 'Bottoming' near the floor of its range (pos 9.0). The tell is policy, not geopolitics: the Trump-era Pentagon paired a record headline budget with DOGE-driven efficiency cuts (~8%/yr reprioritization), threatening legacy programs (F-35, armored vehicles) the primes lean on, while favoring drones, hypersonics and software. After cresting in January 2026 (+111% off the April-2025 low), defense rolled over -18% into March and has only limped back. The group is a value-coiled spring waiting on order flow to validate the demand, not a momentum leader.
defense.now_zh: 国防与航空航天（RTX/LMT/GD/波音，ITA 为代理）所处的世界看似为其量身定做，却深陷冷宫。两场热战——俄乌冲突已拖入第四年，中东在 2026 年 6 月伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击后于月中停火——加上北约重整军备，本应是顺风。然而该篮子在面板上相对强度排名第 32 位，被标记为'筑底'，接近区间底部（pos 9.0）。关键在政策而非地缘：特朗普时代的五角大楼一边端出创纪录的预算总额，一边推行 DOGE 主导的效率削减（每年约 8% 的重新排序），威胁到主承包商赖以为生的传统项目（F-35、装甲车），转而青睐无人机、高超音速武器和软件。在 2026 年 1 月见顶后（较 2025 年 4 月低点 +111%），国防板块下挫 18% 至 3 月，至今仅勉强回血。该板块是一根估值蓄势的弹簧，等待订单流验证需求，而非动量领头羊。

2020-07-09.title: Post-COVID grind higher into the Ukraine bid (+70%)
2020-07-09.body: Defense climbed off the 2020 COVID trough and accelerated when Russia massed on Ukraine's border. The February 2022 invasion turned a steady cyclical recovery into a hard geopolitical re-rating — primes like LMT and RTX bid as Europe woke up to a multi-decade rearmament cycle. The leg topped in March 2022, right at the invasion's emotional peak.
drivers: Russia-Ukraine invasion (Feb 2022) ignites a European rearmament re-rate
Flight-to-defensive-quality as the Fed-hiking bear began
2020-07-09.title_zh: 新冠后缓步走高，迎来俄乌买盘（+70%）
2020-07-09.body_zh: 国防板块自 2020 年新冠低谷爬升，并在俄罗斯陈兵乌克兰边境时加速。2022 年 2 月的入侵把稳健的周期复苏变成了强烈的地缘重估——随着欧洲意识到长达数十年的重整军备周期，LMT、RTX 等主承包商获得买盘。该腿段在 2022 年 3 月、即入侵情绪高峰时见顶。
drivers_zh: 俄乌战争爆发（2022 年 2 月）点燃欧洲重整军备重估
数十年北约国防预算上行周期叙事
美联储加息熊市开启时的防御性优质资产避险

2022-03-25.title: Hiking-bear pullback off the war spike (-21%)
2022-03-25.body: Even a war bid couldn't fully resist the 2022 Fed-hiking bear. After the invasion-driven spike, defense gave back ground into the broad June-2022 market low as rate fears and recession talk dominated. The de-rate was macro, not fundamental — order books were swelling even as multiples compressed.
drivers: Aggressive Fed rate hikes compress all equity multiples
Recession fears pull capital from cyclicals
Profit-taking after the sharp invasion-week spike
2022-03-25.title_zh: 加息熊市从战争尖峰回落（-21%）
2022-03-25.body_zh: 即便有战争买盘，也难抵 2022 年美联储加息熊市。在入侵驱动的尖峰之后，随着利率担忧和衰退论调主导市场，国防板块回吐至 2022 年 6 月的大盘低点。这是宏观去估值而非基本面恶化——倍数压缩之际订单簿仍在膨胀。
drivers_zh: 美联储激进加息压缩所有股票倍数
衰退担忧促使资金撤离周期股
入侵当周急升后的获利了结

2022-06-16.title: Summer relief bounce (+23%)
2022-06-16.body: Defense rode the broad mid-2022 relief rally as the market sniffed a Fed pause that never came. A fast, multiple-driven bounce off oversold levels rather than a new fundamental leg.
drivers: Broad oversold relief rally across equities
Continued strong order backlog as a floor under the group
2022-06-16.body_zh: 国防板块搭上 2022 年年中的大盘纾困反弹，市场嗅到一个最终并未到来的美联储暂停。这是从超卖水平出发、由倍数驱动的快速反弹，而非新的基本面腿段。
drivers_zh: 股市普遍超卖纾困反弹
过早的'美联储转向'预期
强劲订单积压为板块托底

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole hawkish flush (-19%)
2022-08-16.body: Powell's hawkish Jackson Hole reset killed the summer rally and dragged defense into the September-2022 capitulation low alongside everything else. Macro de-risking, not a defense-specific problem.
drivers: Hawkish Jackson Hole repricing of terminal rates
Broad equity capitulation into the autumn low
2022-08-16.body_zh: 鲍威尔在杰克逊霍尔的鹰派重置终结了夏季反弹，把国防板块连同其他一切拖入 2022 年 9 月的投降低点。这是宏观去风险，而非国防特有问题。
drivers_zh: 杰克逊霍尔鹰派重新定价终端利率
股市普遍投降至秋季低点
美元飙升施压跨国企业

2022-09-30.title: The long war-and-budget bull market (+150%)
2022-09-30.body: From the autumn-2022 low, defense ran for over two years — its best stretch of the cycle. Sustained Ukraine resupply, the October-2023 Mideast escalation, surging NATO budgets and a steady backlog all compounded into a +150% advance that topped in January 2025. This is the structural bull case for the group in pure form: war demand meeting record spending.
drivers: Sustained Russia-Ukraine resupply and replenishment orders
Oct-2023 Mideast war adds a second conflict bid
NATO members ratcheting toward and above 2% of GDP
AI/2023 rally lifting the whole risk complex
2022-09-30.title_zh: 漫长的战争与预算牛市（+150%）
2022-09-30.body_zh: 从 2022 年秋季低点起，国防板块连涨两年多——本周期最强一段。持续的乌克兰补给、2023 年 10 月的中东升级、激增的北约预算和稳定的积压，共同推升 +150% 涨幅，于 2025 年 1 月见顶。这是该板块结构性牛市逻辑的纯粹形态：战争需求遇上创纪录开支。
drivers_zh: 持续的俄乌补给与补充订单
2023 年 10 月中东战争增添第二处冲突买盘
北约成员国预算迈向并超过 GDP 2%
AI/2023 年反弹抬升整个风险资产群

2025-01-21.title: Trump-trade unwind & DOGE cut fears (-15%)
2025-01-21.body: The new administration's signals flipped the script. Talk of halving defense spending, an 8%/yr DOGE-driven reprioritization and threats to legacy programs (F-35, armored vehicles) hit the primes — LMT and RTX shed mid-single-digits on the headlines. DeepSeek's late-January AI scare and broad risk-off compounded it. The 'Trump = more defense' assumption broke.
drivers: Threats to legacy programs the primes depend on
DeepSeek shock and broad late-Jan risk-off
2025-01-21.title_zh: 特朗普交易平仓与 DOGE 削减恐慌（-15%）
2025-01-21.body_zh: 新政府的信号扭转了剧本。关于国防开支减半、每年 8% 的 DOGE 主导重新排序，以及对传统项目（F-35、装甲车）的威胁，冲击了主承包商——LMT、RTX 因消息下跌中个位数。DeepSeek 1 月底的 AI 恐慌和普遍避险加剧了跌势。'特朗普=更多国防'的假设破裂。
drivers_zh: DOGE 五角大楼效率行动瞄准每年约 8% 削减
威胁主承包商赖以为生的传统项目
DeepSeek 冲击与 1 月底普遍避险

2025-04-04.title: Recovery off the tariff-crash low (+111%)
2025-04-04.body: Defense bottomed with the whole market at the April-8 reciprocal-tariff crash and then staged its sharpest run of the cycle. A re-escalating geopolitical backdrop, allied rearmament and a re-think of the cut narrative drove it +111% into a January-2026 peak — the basket's most explosive single leg, snapping back from deeply oversold.
drivers: Snap-back off the April-2025 reciprocal-tariff crash low
Allied rearmament and Ukraine/Mideast escalation re-bid
Reassessment of the worst-case budget-cut fears
2025-04-04.body_zh: 国防板块随整个市场在 4 月 8 日对等关税崩盘中触底，随后上演本周期最陡的一段。地缘背景再度升级、盟友重整军备、对削减叙事的重新思考，推升其 +111% 至 2026 年 1 月高点——该篮子最具爆发力的单腿，从深度超卖中弹回。
drivers_zh: 从 2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘低点弹回
盟友重整军备与乌克兰/中东升级再买入
对最坏情形预算削减担忧的重新评估

2026-01-16.title: Top rolls over on budget reality (-18%)
2026-01-16.body: The January-2026 high faded as budget reality reasserted itself — the headline DOGE reprioritization, a strong dollar pressuring exports and rotation out of the leg's parabolic run. Defense gave back -18% into late March, which set up its current bottoming, lagging posture.
drivers: Strong dollar (2026 Hormuz oil shock) headwind for exporters
2026-01-16.title_zh: 见顶后因预算现实回落（-18%）
2026-01-16.body_zh: 随着预算现实重新主导，2026 年 1 月高点回落——DOGE 重新排序、强势美元压制出口、以及从抛物线行情中轮动出场。国防板块下挫 18% 至 3 月底，奠定了当前筑底、落后的姿态。
drivers_zh: 预算削减与项目合理化现实重新定价
强势美元（2026 年霍尔木兹石油冲击）对出口商构成逆风
抛物线 +111% 腿段后的轮动/获利了结

2026-03-30.title: Tentative bottoming bounce (+16%)
2026-03-30.body: A shallow recovery off the March low, but without the relative-strength leadership to confirm a new uptrend — the basket still ranks #32. Helped at the margin by the June-2026 Mideast flare and ceasefire keeping defense demand in the headlines, but order flow, not news, is what the group needs to re-rate.
drivers: Oversold bounce off the March-2026 low
June-2026 Iran/Hormuz flare keeps defense demand topical
Awaiting order-book confirmation; RS still lagging at #32
2026-03-30.body_zh: 从 3 月低点出发的浅幅回升，但缺乏相对强度领导力来确认新上升趋势——该篮子仍排第 32 位。2026 年 6 月中东突发与停火让国防需求保持在头条，对其边际有利，但板块重估需要的是订单流而非新闻。
drivers_zh: 从 2026 年 3 月低点超卖反弹
2026 年 6 月伊朗/霍尔木兹突发使国防需求保持热度
等待订单簿确认；相对强度仍落后于第 32 位

reshoring.now: Reshoring & Industrial Capex (XLI proxy) is the policy-tailwind trade with the receipts. The CHIPS Act, IRA and IIJA have driven a genuine factory-construction boom — manufacturing construction spending roughly tripled from ~$80B/yr (2019) to ~$224B/yr by late 2025, with $630B+ committed across 140 semiconductor projects alone. The 2024 Trump election then layered an explicit reshoring/tariff lever on top: the April-2025 reciprocal tariffs were a body-blow to globalized supply chains in the moment, but the structural intent is to drag production onshore. The basket is 'Trending', mid-pack at RS-rank #16 and pos 60.4 — a durable secondary leader riding electrification and AI-power capex, up +89% since the April-2025 low, but not a parabolic momentum name like the chip-equipment complex.
reshoring.now_zh: 制造业回流与工业资本开支（XLI 为代理）是有实据支撑的政策顺风交易。CHIPS 法案、IRA 和 IIJA 已驱动一场真实的工厂建设热潮——制造业建设开支从 2019 年约 800 亿美元/年大致翻三倍至 2025 年底的约 2240 亿美元/年，仅半导体一项就有 140 个项目承诺投资逾 6300 亿美元。2024 年特朗普当选又叠加了一根明确的回流/关税杠杆：2025 年 4 月的对等关税当下重创了全球化供应链，但其结构性意图是把生产拖回本土。该篮子'趋势中'，相对强度排名居中（第 16 位），pos 60.4——一个搭乘电气化与 AI 电力资本开支的耐久次级领头羊，自 2025 年 4 月低点 +89%，但不像芯片设备群那样是抛物线动量品种。

2021-11-16.title: Hiking-bear de-rate (-25%)
2021-11-16.body: Industrials de-rated through the first half of 2022 as the Fed-hiking bear and China's COVID lockdowns crushed cyclical sentiment and snarled supply chains. The reshoring thesis was nascent — the CHIPS Act wouldn't pass until August 2022 — so the group traded as plain cyclicals into the June low.
drivers: China COVID lockdowns disrupt supply chains
Reshoring policy not yet a catalyst (pre-CHIPS Act)
2021-11-16.body_zh: 随着美联储加息熊市和中国新冠封控压垮周期情绪、扰乱供应链，工业板块在 2022 年上半年去估值。回流主题尚处萌芽——CHIPS 法案要到 2022 年 8 月才通过——因此该板块作为普通周期股交易至 6 月低点。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息熊市压缩周期股倍数
中国新冠封控扰乱供应链
回流政策尚未成为催化剂（CHIPS 法案前）

2022-07-14.title: Summer pause-hope bounce (+23%)
2022-07-14.body: A broad relief rally off the June low on premature Fed-pause hopes lifted industrials with everything else. The CHIPS Act passing in August added an emerging structural narrative under the cyclical bounce.
drivers: CHIPS Act passage (Aug 2022) seeds the reshoring thesis
2022-07-14.body_zh: 因过早的美联储暂停预期，从 6 月低点出发的大盘纾困反弹连同其他一切抬升了工业板块。8 月 CHIPS 法案通过，在周期反弹之下增添了一个新兴的结构性叙事。
drivers_zh: CHIPS 法案通过（2022 年 8 月）播下回流主题种子
过早的'美联储暂停'仓位

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole flush (-18%)
2022-08-16.body: Powell's hawkish reset ended the summer bounce and dragged the group into the autumn-2022 capitulation low. Macro, not fundamental — factory-construction commitments kept building underneath the price weakness.
drivers: Broad equity capitulation into autumn low
2022-08-16.body_zh: 鲍威尔的鹰派重置终结了夏季反弹，把板块拖入 2022 年秋季投降低点。这是宏观而非基本面——在价格疲软之下，工厂建设承诺仍在累积。
drivers_zh: 杰克逊霍尔鹰派终端利率重新定价
股市普遍投降至秋季低点
美元走强施压工业跨国企业

2022-09-27.title: The reshoring bull market (+103%)
2022-09-27.body: From the autumn-2022 low industrials more than doubled over two-plus years — the cleanest expression of the reshoring/capex super-cycle. CHIPS/IRA/IIJA money flowed into shovels-in-the-ground projects, the 2023 AI rally lifted risk, and 2024's Fed-cut start plus the November election's 'Trump reshoring trade' compounded the bid into a November-2024 top.
drivers: CHIPS/IRA/IIJA funding hits real construction spend
2023 AI rally and 2024 Fed cuts lift the risk complex
Electrification and AI-power capex emerging as a fresh leg
2022-09-27.body_zh: 从 2022 年秋季低点起，工业板块在两年多里翻倍有余——回流/资本开支超级周期最清晰的表达。CHIPS/IRA/IIJA 资金流入破土动工的项目，2023 年 AI 反弹抬升风险，2024 年美联储开启降息加上 11 月大选的'特朗普回流交易'，把买盘叠加至 2024 年 11 月高点。
drivers_zh: CHIPS/IRA/IIJA 资金落地为实际建设开支
2023 年 AI 反弹与 2024 年美联储降息抬升风险资产群
2024 年 11 月大选确立'回流/特朗普交易'
电气化与 AI 电力资本开支成为新腿段

2024-11-26.title: Tariff-crash selloff (-28%)
2024-11-26.body: The 'Trump trade' euphoria gave way to its dark side. Tariff uncertainty through early 2025 culminated in the April-8 reciprocal-tariff crash, which hit globalized industrial supply chains hardest — input costs, retaliation risk and demand fears all at once. Reshoring beneficiaries sold off with the broad market despite being the structural winners of the policy.
drivers: April-2025 reciprocal-tariff crash hits supply chains
Rotation out of a parabolic two-year industrial run
2024-11-26.body_zh: '特朗普交易'的狂热让位于其阴暗面。2025 年初的关税不确定性在 4 月 8 日对等关税崩盘中达到顶点，对全球化工业供应链打击最重——投入成本、报复风险和需求担忧同时袭来。回流受益者虽是该政策的结构性赢家，却随大盘抛售。
drivers_zh: 2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘冲击供应链
关税投入成本与报复担忧
从抛物线式两年工业行情中轮动出场

2025-04-08.title: Recovery & AI-power capex leg (+89%)
2025-04-08.body: Off the April-8 low, reshoring recovered strongly and broadened: the tariff regime that caused the crash also hardens the long-run onshoring case, while electrification and AI-datacenter-power capex became a second engine. Up +89% into June 2026, the basket is a steady secondary leader (RS #16) — durable, policy-backed, but not a momentum darling.
drivers: Snap-back off the April-2025 crash low
Tariff regime reinforces structural onshoring incentive
Electrification + AI-datacenter-power capex as a fresh demand engine
Record manufacturing-construction spend (~$224B/yr) underpins the trend
2025-04-08.title_zh: 回升与 AI 电力资本开支腿段（+89%）
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从 4 月 8 日低点起，回流强势回升并扩散：引发崩盘的关税体制也强化了长期本土化逻辑，而电气化与 AI 数据中心电力资本开支成为第二引擎。至 2026 年 6 月 +89%，该篮子是稳健的次级领头羊（相对强度第 16 位）——耐久、有政策支撑，但非动量宠儿。
drivers_zh: 从 2025 年 4 月崩盘低点弹回
关税体制强化结构性本土化激励
电气化+AI 数据中心电力资本开支成为新需求引擎
创纪录的制造业建设开支（约 2240 亿美元/年）支撑趋势

robotics_automation.now: Robotics & Automation (ABB/ROK/industrial controls, machine vision, surgical robotics; BOTZ proxy) is a quality industrial-tech theme caught mid-correction. It's tagged 'Rolling over' at RS-rank #20, pos 35.9 — the basket nearly doubled (+90%) off the April-2025 tariff-crash low into a May-2026 high, then began consolidating. The thesis fuses two strands: classic factory-automation capex (which overlaps reshoring) and the newer 'physical AI / humanoid' narrative that re-rated the group through 2024-25. Near-term it's digesting a parabolic run against a strong-dollar, sticky-CPI 2026 backdrop that pressures the industrial-multinational and capital-equipment buyers at the heart of the basket.
robotics_automation.now_zh: 机器人与自动化（ABB/ROK/工业控制、机器视觉、手术机器人；BOTZ 为代理）是一个处于回调中段的优质工业科技主题。它被标记为'见顶回落'，相对强度排名第 20 位，pos 35.9——该篮子从 2025 年 4 月关税崩盘低点近乎翻倍（+90%）至 2026 年 5 月高点，随后开始盘整。其逻辑融合两条线：经典的工厂自动化资本开支（与回流重叠）和较新的'实体 AI/人形机器人'叙事，后者在 2024-25 年间重估了该板块。短期内，它正消化一段抛物线行情，背景是强势美元和粘性 CPI 的 2026 年，这压制了位于该篮子核心的工业跨国企业和资本设备买家。

2021-12-27.title: Hiking-bear de-rate (-29%)
2021-12-27.body: High-multiple automation/robotics names led the 2022 growth-stock de-rate as the Fed hiked. Long-duration industrial-tech with rich valuations got hit harder than plain cyclicals into the May-2022 low.
drivers: Fed hiking crushes long-duration growth multiples
Risk-off rotation out of high-beta industrial tech
2021-12-27.body_zh: 随着美联储加息，高倍数的自动化/机器人个股领跌 2022 年成长股去估值。估值丰厚的长久期工业科技在 2022 年 5 月低点前所受冲击重于普通周期股。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息压垮长久期成长倍数
供应链/元件短缺冲击硬件
从高贝塔工业科技中轮动避险

2022-05-11.title: Summer relief bounce (+26%)
2022-05-11.body: Caught the broad mid-2022 relief rally off oversold on premature Fed-pause hopes. A multiple-driven bounce, not a fundamental turn.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 因过早的美联储暂停预期，从超卖中搭上 2022 年年中的大盘纾困反弹。这是倍数驱动的反弹，而非基本面转折。
drivers_zh: 成长/科技普遍超卖纾困反弹
过早的'美联储转向'预期
元件短缺缓解的乐观情绪

2022-08-12.title: Jackson Hole flush (-21%)
2022-08-12.body: Powell's hawkish reset ended the bounce into the autumn-2022 capitulation low. Pure macro de-risking of long-duration tech.
2022-08-12.body_zh: 鲍威尔的鹰派重置终结反弹，跌至 2022 年秋季投降低点。纯粹是对长久期科技的宏观去风险。
drivers_zh: 杰克逊霍尔鹰派重新定价
美元飙升施压工业跨国企业

2022-09-27.title: AI-rally recovery (+63%)
2022-09-27.body: From the autumn-2022 low the group rode the 2023 AI rally and easing-rate hopes higher, with automation re-rating as a near-AI industrial-tech beneficiary. Topped in July 2023 as the early-AI enthusiasm cooled.
2022-09-27.body_zh: 从 2022 年秋季低点起，该板块搭乘 2023 年 AI 反弹和宽松预期走高，自动化作为近 AI 工业科技受益者获重估。随早期 AI 热情降温于 2023 年 7 月见顶。
drivers_zh: 2023 年 AI 反弹抬升工业科技相邻领域
宽松预期修复成长倍数
回流资本开支叙事支撑订单簿

2023-07-31.title: Rate-scare pullback (-22%)
2023-07-31.body: The autumn-2023 bond-yield spike (10Y toward 5%) hit rate-sensitive growth and industrial-tech. A clean rates-driven correction into the late-October low.
2023-07-31.body_zh: 2023 年秋季债券收益率飙升（10 年期逼近 5%）冲击了利率敏感的成长与工业科技。一次干净的利率驱动回调，跌至 10 月底低点。
drivers_zh: 10 年期收益率飙升逼近 5%（2023 年秋）
更高更久重新定价冲击成长倍数
AI 反弹腿段后的获利了结

2023-11-01.title: Soft-landing & Fed-cut rally (+48%)
2023-11-01.body: The late-2023 dovish pivot and 2024 soft-landing/rate-cut run lifted automation alongside broad risk into a July-2024 top. Reshoring capex and early physical-AI optimism added a thematic bid.
drivers: Late-2023 Fed dovish pivot, 2024 cut cycle
2023-11-01.title_zh: 软着陆与美联储降息反弹（+48%）
2023-11-01.body_zh: 2023 年底的鸽派转向和 2024 年软着陆/降息行情，连同大盘风险偏好把自动化抬升至 2024 年 7 月高点。回流资本开支与早期实体 AI 乐观情绪增添了主题买盘。
drivers_zh: 2023 年底美联储鸽派转向、2024 年降息周期
软着陆风险偏好遍及周期股/科技
回流资本开支+早期'实体 AI'叙事

2024-07-16.title: Yen-carry unwind flush (-16%)
2024-07-16.body: The early-August 2024 yen-carry-trade unwind hit high-beta growth globally; automation flushed with the complex into the August low. Sharp and brief.
2024-07-16.body_zh: 2024 年 8 月初的日元套利交易平仓打击了全球高贝塔成长；自动化随整个群组冲刷至 8 月低点。急促而短暂。
drivers_zh: 2024 年 8 月日元套利交易平仓

2024-08-07.title: Election & physical-AI bid (+26%)
2024-08-07.body: Recovered off the August low into a November-2024 high on the 'Trump reshoring trade' and intensifying physical-AI/humanoid enthusiasm. Capex optimism met a thematic re-rating.
2024-08-07.title_zh: 大选与实体 AI 买盘（+26%）
2024-08-07.body_zh: 从 8 月低点回升至 2024 年 11 月高点，受'特朗普回流交易'和日益高涨的实体 AI/人形机器人热情驱动。资本开支乐观情绪遇上主题重估。
drivers_zh: 2024 年 11 月大选'回流/特朗普交易'
实体 AI/人形机器人叙事升温

2024-11-25.title: Tariff-crash selloff (-33%)
2024-11-25.body: Robotics took a deep hit into the April-8 reciprocal-tariff crash — its globalized hardware supply chains and capital-equipment demand are squarely in the tariff blast radius. A -33% drawdown, among the basket's harshest of the cycle.
drivers: April-2025 reciprocal-tariff crash hits hardware supply chains
2024-11-25.body_zh: 机器人板块在 4 月 8 日对等关税崩盘中深度受挫——其全球化硬件供应链和资本设备需求正处关税冲击半径之内。-33% 回撤，是该篮子本周期最严酷之一。
drivers_zh: 2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘冲击硬件供应链
DeepSeek 引领的科技去估值（2025 年 1 月）加剧跌势

2025-04-08.title: Recovery & physical-AI re-rate (+90%)
2025-04-08.body: Off the April-8 low robotics nearly doubled (+90%) into a May-2026 high as the physical-AI/humanoid narrative re-accelerated and reshoring capex underpinned orders. The leg is now rolling over as the basket digests a parabolic run against a strong-dollar, sticky-CPI 2026 backdrop.
drivers: Snap-back off the April-2025 crash low
2026 strong dollar / sticky CPI pressures capital-equipment buyers
2025-04-08.title_zh: 回升与实体 AI 重估（+90%）
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从 4 月 8 日低点起，机器人近乎翻倍（+90%）至 2026 年 5 月高点，因实体 AI/人形机器人叙事再加速、回流资本开支支撑订单。该腿段如今正见顶回落，篮子在强势美元、粘性 CPI 的 2026 年背景下消化一段抛物线行情。
drivers_zh: 从 2025 年 4 月崩盘低点弹回
实体 AI/人形机器人重估再加速
回流资本开支订单支撑
2026 年强势美元/粘性 CPI 压制资本设备买家

space_economy.now: Space Economy (RKLB/launch/satcom/Earth-obs, ARKX proxy) is the high-beta speculative end of the industrials complex — a basket that moves in violent 30-40% swings in both directions. It's 'Rolling over' at RS-rank #26, pos 43.9, having just dumped -42% off a late-May-2026 high. The 2023-25 era turned space from a SPAC-graveyard into a credible build-out: launch cadence, direct-to-device satcom, Earth observation and a defense-space bid. But RKLB-style names trade like long-duration call options — the late-2025/2026 Neutron-rocket delays and qualification setbacks triggered exactly the kind of 35%+ drawdowns this group is prone to, even with backlogs intact. High torque, low quality of trend; size accordingly.
space_economy.now_zh: 太空经济（RKLB/发射/卫星通信/对地观测，ARKX 为代理）是工业群组中高贝塔的投机端——一个在两个方向都以剧烈 30-40% 摆幅运动的篮子。它'见顶回落'，相对强度排名第 26 位，pos 43.9，刚从 2026 年 5 月底高点暴跌 -42%。2023-25 年间，太空从 SPAC 坟场变成可信的建设浪潮：发射节奏、直连设备卫星通信、对地观测和国防航天买盘。但 RKLB 这类个股交易起来像长久期看涨期权——2025 年底/2026 年的 Neutron 火箭延期与资格测试挫折，恰恰触发了该板块易发的 35%+ 回撤，即便积压订单完好。高扭矩、低趋势质量；据此控制仓位。

2021-02-19.title: SPAC-bubble unwind (-44%)
2021-02-19.body: Space de-SPACs and speculative names led the 2021-22 unwind well before the broad bear. As liquidity tightened and the Fed pivoted hawkish, the most speculative, profitless corner of growth got hit first and hardest into the February-2022 low.
drivers: Fed-hiking pivot punishes profitless growth first
Risk-off rotation out of long-duration story stocks
2021-02-19.body_zh: 太空 de-SPAC 和投机性个股早在大盘熊市之前就领跌 2021-22 年的破裂。随着流动性收紧、美联储转鹰，最具投机性、无盈利的成长角落最先、最重地受挫至 2022 年 2 月低点。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息转向最先惩罚无盈利成长
从长久期故事股中轮动避险

2022-02-23.title: Sharp dead-cat bounce (+28%)
2022-02-23.body: A high-beta oversold snap-back, typical of this group's violent two-way moves. No fundamental turn — just speculative torque off a deep low.
2022-02-23.body_zh: 高贝塔超卖弹回，是该板块剧烈双向运动的典型。无基本面转折——只是从深低点出发的投机扭矩。

2022-04-04.title: Hiking-bear flush (-33%)
2022-04-04.body: Resumed the broad 2022 decline as the Fed-hiking bear intensified into the June low. Speculative space got no shelter.
2022-04-04.body_zh: 随美联储加息熊市加剧至 6 月低点，恢复 2022 年大盘下跌。投机性太空板块毫无庇护。
drivers_zh: 流动性撤出对投机打击最重

2022-05-11.title: Summer relief bounce (+42%)
2022-05-11.body: A big high-beta bounce off the spring low on premature Fed-pause hopes — the upside mirror of this group's outsized drawdowns.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 因过早的美联储暂停预期，从春季低点出发的高贝塔大反弹——是该板块超大回撤的上行镜像。
drivers_zh: 过早的'美联储暂停'纾困反弹
从超卖出发的高贝塔上行扭矩

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole flush (-34%)
2022-08-16.body: Powell's hawkish reset sent speculative space into the December-2022 low. High-beta names lagged the broad late-2022 recovery as liquidity stayed tight.
2022-08-16.body_zh: 鲍威尔的鹰派重置把投机性太空板块送入 2022 年 12 月低点。流动性持续偏紧，高贝塔个股落后于 2022 年底的大盘复苏。
drivers_zh: 紧流动性对投机的惩罚

2022-12-27.title: January high-beta squeeze (+83%)
2022-12-27.body: A ferocious early-2023 high-beta rally as the most-shorted, most-oversold speculation ripped on the 'soft landing' re-risk. Topped fast in February 2023.
2022-12-27.body_zh: 2023 年初凶猛的高贝塔反弹，最被做空、最超卖的投机品种在'软着陆'再担风险中暴涨。于 2023 年 2 月快速见顶。
drivers_zh: 从深低点出发的投机均值回归

2023-02-22.title: Rate-scare grind lower (-44%)
2023-02-22.body: Space gave most of the squeeze back through 2023 as the SVB scare, then the autumn yield spike, hammered speculation. A long, grinding -44% into the October-2023 low.
2023-02-22.body_zh: 随 SVB 恐慌、继而秋季收益率飙升重击投机，太空板块在 2023 年间回吐了大部分逼空涨幅。一段漫长缓慢的 -44%，跌至 2023 年 10 月低点。
drivers_zh: SVB 区域银行恐慌（2023 年 3 月）
2023 年秋 10 年期收益率飙升逼近 5%
投机在更高更久下被去估值

2023-10-27.title: The space build-out bull market (+381%)
2023-10-27.body: The defining leg: from the October-2023 low space ran +381% over 16 months. The Fed dovish pivot, the 2024 cut cycle, and — crucially — a genuine fundamental shift (launch cadence scaling, direct-to-device satcom, Earth-obs, a defense-space bid) turned the SPAC graveyard into a credible build-out. RKLB-type names led the re-rating into the February-2025 top.
drivers: Late-2023 Fed dovish pivot + 2024 cut cycle
Real fundamentals: launch cadence, satcom, Earth-obs, defense-space
Speculative risk-on rotation into the highest-torque theme
SPAC-era survivors mature into investable businesses
2023-10-27.body_zh: 决定性的一段：从 2023 年 10 月低点起，太空板块在 16 个月内上涨 +381%。美联储鸽派转向、2024 年降息周期，以及——关键地——一次真实的基本面转变（发射节奏扩张、直连设备卫星通信、对地观测、国防航天买盘），把 SPAC 坟场变成可信的建设浪潮。RKLB 这类个股领涨重估至 2025 年 2 月高点。
drivers_zh: 2023 年底美联储鸽派转向+2024 年降息周期
真实基本面：发射节奏、卫星通信、对地观测、国防航天
投机性风险偏好轮入扭矩最高的主题
SPAC 时代幸存者成长为可投资企业

2025-02-10.title: DeepSeek & tariff de-risk (-40%)
2025-02-10.body: Speculative space led the early-2025 de-risk: the DeepSeek AI scare, then the April-8 reciprocal-tariff crash, flushed the highest-beta theme hard into the April low.
2025-02-10.body_zh: 投机性太空板块领跌 2025 年初的去风险：DeepSeek AI 恐慌、继而 4 月 8 日对等关税崩盘，把扭矩最高的主题狠狠冲刷至 4 月低点。
drivers_zh: DeepSeek AI 恐慌（2025 年 1 月）冲击投机
2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘
高贝塔领跌大盘去风险

2025-04-08.title: Tariff-low moonshot (+154%)
2025-04-08.body: Classic high-beta torque off the April-8 low: +154% into an October-2025 high as risk-on returned and the build-out narrative re-engaged. Speculative space does this — vertical rallies that demand respect for both directions.
drivers: Snap-back off the April-2025 crash low
High-beta upside torque in a risk-on tape
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从 4 月 8 日低点出发的经典高贝塔扭矩：随风险偏好回归、建设叙事重新发力，+154% 至 2025 年 10 月高点。投机性太空板块就是如此——垂直拉升，要求对两个方向都心存敬畏。
drivers_zh: 从 2025 年 4 月崩盘低点弹回
建设叙事重新发力（发射、卫星通信、国防航天）
风险偏好行情中的高贝塔上行扭矩

2025-10-15.title: Autumn high-beta flush (-39%)
2025-10-15.body: A sharp high-beta correction off the October high — speculative space front-ran a broad late-2025 risk wobble with its usual outsized drawdown.
2025-10-15.body_zh: 从 10 月高点出发的急剧高贝塔回调——投机性太空板块以其惯常的超大回撤抢跑 2025 年底的大盘风险动摇。
drivers_zh: +154% 行情后的高贝塔获利了结

2025-11-20.title: Year-end rip (+120%)
2025-11-20.body: Another vertical high-beta rally — +120% into late January 2026 — on renewed risk-on and launch/contract milestones. Pure speculative torque off an oversold low.
2025-11-20.body_zh: 又一次垂直的高贝塔反弹——+120% 至 2026 年 1 月底——受风险偏好重燃与发射/合同里程碑驱动。从超卖低点出发的纯投机扭矩。
drivers_zh: 年末/新年风险偏好重燃
从超卖出发的高贝塔上行扭矩

2026-01-28.title: Quick correction (-26%)
2026-01-28.body: A fast pullback off the January high — routine volatility for a basket that swings 25%+ on sentiment and single-name news (notably emerging Neutron-rocket timeline worries).
drivers: Routine high-beta pullback after a +120% run
2026-01-28.body_zh: 从 1 月高点出发的快速回落——对一个因情绪和单一个股新闻（尤其是新兴的 Neutron 火箭时间线担忧）就摆动 25%+ 的篮子而言是常规波动。
drivers_zh: +120% 行情后的常规高贝塔回落
早期 Neutron 火箭时间线担忧（RKLB）

2026-02-12.title: Spring melt-up (+115%)
2026-02-12.body: Yet another +115% high-beta surge into a late-May-2026 peak. The build-out story stayed intact and risk appetite carried the highest-torque theme to a new high.
drivers: High-beta upside torque to a new cycle high
2026-02-12.body_zh: 又一次 +115% 的高贝塔飙升，至 2026 年 5 月底高点。建设故事保持完好，风险偏好把扭矩最高的主题推向新高。
drivers_zh: 建设基本面（发射节奏、卫星通信、国防航天）
高贝塔上行扭矩创周期新高

2026-05-28.title: Neutron-delay drawdown (-42%)
2026-05-28.body: The current selloff. RKLB-style names dumped as Neutron-rocket qualification setbacks and a delayed maiden flight (slipping toward mid-2026) collided with profit-taking off a parabolic high — exactly the 35%+ drawdown this group is structurally prone to. Backlogs stayed intact ($1B+), but space trades on milestones and torque, not on backlog. The basket is now 'Rolling over' (RS #26), a high-volatility theme back in its risk-off phase.
drivers: Profit-taking off a parabolic late-May high
High-beta de-risk into a strong-dollar 2026 backdrop
2026-05-28.body_zh: 当前的抛售。RKLB 这类个股因 Neutron 火箭资格测试受挫、首飞延期（滑向 2026 年年中）与抛物线高点的获利了结叠加而暴跌——正是该板块结构性易发的 35%+ 回撤。积压订单保持完好（逾 10 亿美元），但太空板块靠的是里程碑和扭矩，而非积压。该篮子如今'见顶回落'（相对强度第 26 位），一个高波动主题重回其避险阶段。
drivers_zh: Neutron 火箭资格测试受挫/首飞延期（RKLB）
5 月底抛物线高点的获利了结
强势美元 2026 年背景下的高贝塔去风险
里程碑驱动的抛售，尽管逾 10 亿美元积压完好

industrial_distribution.now: Industrial Distribution & Capital Goods (Grainger/Fastenal-type MRO distributors, equipment rental, short-cycle tooling; XLI proxy) is the late-cycle workhorse — the boring-but-effective end of industrials. It's 'Trending' at RS-rank #15, pos 67.2, up +58% off the April-2025 tariff-crash low and grinding toward the upper half of its range. The thesis is restock + nonresidential construction + pricing power: distributors monetize the reshoring/electrification build-out by selling the picks-and-shovels (fasteners, tools, MRO) to everyone constructing factories and grids. Quality, steady, pricing-power compounders rather than a torque trade — which is precisely why they hold up better than the speculative themes when the tape gets choppy.
industrial_distribution.now_zh: 工业分销与资本货物（Grainger/Fastenal 这类 MRO 分销商、设备租赁、短周期工具；XLI 为代理）是后周期的主力——工业群组中乏味却有效的一端。它'趋势中'，相对强度排名第 15 位，pos 67.2，自 2025 年 4 月关税崩盘低点 +58%，缓步迈向区间上半部。其逻辑是补库+非住宅建设+定价权：分销商通过向所有建工厂、建电网的人出售'镐与铲'（紧固件、工具、MRO）来变现回流/电气化建设浪潮。它们是优质、稳健、有定价权的复利机器，而非扭矩交易——这恰恰是它们在行情震荡时比投机主题更抗跌的原因。

2021-11-16.title: Hiking-bear de-rate (-25%)
2021-11-16.body: Distributors de-rated through H1 2022 with the broad cyclical complex as the Fed hiked and recession fears mounted. A multiple compression, not an earnings break — short-cycle demand stayed firm under the price weakness.
drivers: Recession fears pressure short-cycle demand outlook
2021-11-16.body_zh: 随美联储加息、衰退担忧加剧，分销商连同大盘周期群组在 2022 年上半年去估值。这是倍数压缩而非盈利断裂——价格疲软之下短周期需求保持稳健。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息熊市压缩周期股倍数
衰退担忧施压短周期需求前景

2022-06-17.title: Summer relief bounce (+26%)
2022-06-17.body: Caught the broad mid-2022 relief rally on premature Fed-pause hopes. Multiple-driven, with resilient distributor fundamentals as a floor.
2022-06-17.body_zh: 因过早的美联储暂停预期，搭上 2022 年年中的大盘纾困反弹。倍数驱动，分销商稳健的基本面提供托底。
drivers_zh: 过早的'美联储暂停'预期
稳健的 MRO/短周期需求

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole flush (-18%)
2022-08-16.body: Powell's hawkish reset ended the bounce into a late-September low. Macro de-risking, briefly overriding the group's defensive-cyclical quality.
2022-08-16.body_zh: 鲍威尔的鹰派重置终结反弹，跌至 9 月底低点。宏观去风险，短暂压过该板块防御性周期的优质属性。
drivers_zh: 杰克逊霍尔鹰派重新定价

2022-09-26.title: The late-cycle compounder bull market (+100%)
2022-09-26.body: From the autumn-2022 low distributors doubled over two-plus years — a steady, quality-led advance. Pricing power held through disinflation, the reshoring/electrification build-out fed nonresidential-construction demand, and 2024's soft landing plus the November 'reshoring trade' carried it to a November-2024 top. This is the late-cycle compounder thesis working cleanly.
drivers: Restock cycle and resilient MRO demand
2022-09-26.body_zh: 从 2022 年秋季低点起，分销商在两年多里翻倍——一段稳健、由优质引领的上涨。定价权在去通胀中保持，回流/电气化建设浪潮喂养非住宅建设需求，2024 年软着陆加 11 月'回流交易'把它带至 2024 年 11 月高点。这是后周期复利机器逻辑干净运行的体现。
drivers_zh: 定价权在 2023-24 去通胀中持续
回流/电气化建设浪潮驱动非住宅建设需求
2024 年软着陆+2024 年 11 月'回流交易'
补库周期与稳健的 MRO 需求

2024-11-25.title: Tariff-crash selloff (-27%)
2024-11-25.body: Sold off into the April-8 reciprocal-tariff crash on input-cost, demand and globalized-supply-chain fears. The drawdown was real but shallower than the higher-beta industrial themes — the group's quality showed.
drivers: Rotation out of a two-year compounder run
2024-11-25.body_zh: 因投入成本、需求和全球化供应链担忧，抛售至 4 月 8 日对等关税崩盘。回撤真实，但浅于高贝塔工业主题——板块的优质属性得以显现。
drivers_zh: 2025 年 4 月对等关税崩盘
投入成本与短周期需求担忧
从两年复利行情中轮动出场

2025-04-08.title: Recovery & build-out leg (+58%)
2025-04-08.body: Off the April-8 low distributors recovered +58% into June 2026 as pricing power held and the reshoring/electrification/AI-power construction wave fed steady demand. The basket is 'Trending' (RS #15) — a quality late-cycle leader that compounds rather than spikes, holding up well even as 2026's strong dollar and sticky CPI pressure the broader capital-goods buyer.
drivers: Snap-back off the April-2025 crash low
Pricing power and restock support margins
Late-cycle quality holds up vs. higher-beta peers
2025-04-08.body_zh: 从 4 月 8 日低点起，分销商回升 +58% 至 2026 年 6 月，因定价权保持、回流/电气化/AI 电力建设浪潮喂养稳定需求。该篮子'趋势中'（相对强度第 15 位）——一个复利而非尖峰的优质后周期领头羊，即便 2026 年强势美元和粘性 CPI 压制更广泛的资本货物买家，它仍表现抗跌。
drivers_zh: 从 2025 年 4 月崩盘低点弹回
回流/电气化/AI 电力建设需求
定价权与补库支撑利润率
后周期优质属性相对高贝塔同行更抗跌

critical_minerals.now: Critical Minerals & Rare Earths (MP Materials/lithium/allied ex-China supply; REMX proxy) is the most policy-driven, most violent basket here — and right now the most beaten-down, tagged 'Bottoming' at pos 1.6, the floor of its range, despite an RS-rank of #27. This is a supply-policy story, not a demand story: China controls rare-earth processing and weaponizes it via export controls (the strict April-2025 regime, then a fresh June-2026 escalation that sanctioned MP Materials and USA Rare Earth and barred 46 US firms — incl. LMT/RTX/Boeing/GD — from Chinese procurement). The US response is state-backed: the Pentagon took ~15% of MP, set a $110/kg NdPr price floor and a 10-year magnet offtake, then lent $725M into the metallization gap. The result is a stock complex that gapped +715% (2024-25) on policy, then whipsawed in 30-43% swings as the trade war escalated and de-escalated (a partial export-control suspension runs to Nov-10-2026). Whippy, headline-hostage, asymmetric — a strategic theme trading like an option on geopolitics.
critical_minerals.now_zh: 关键矿产与稀土（MP Materials/锂/盟友去中国化供应；REMX 为代理）是此处最受政策驱动、最剧烈的篮子——眼下也是被打压最狠的，标记为'筑底'，pos 1.6 处于区间底部，尽管相对强度排名第 27 位。这是供应政策故事而非需求故事：中国掌控稀土加工并以出口管制为武器（2025 年 4 月的严格体制，继而 2026 年 6 月的新一轮升级，制裁了 MP Materials 和 USA Rare Earth，并把 46 家美国企业——含 LMT/RTX/波音/GD——排除出中国政府采购）。美国的回应是国家背书：五角大楼拿下 MP 约 15% 股权，设定 110 美元/公斤的镨钕价格下限和 10 年磁体包销，随后向金属化缺口注入 7.25 亿美元贷款。结果是一个股票群组因政策跳涨 +715%（2024-25），随后在贸易战升级与缓和中以 30-43% 的摆幅来回鞭打（部分出口管制暂停延续至 2026 年 11 月 10 日）。鞭打剧烈、被头条挟持、不对称——一个交易起来像地缘政治期权的战略主题。

2021-11-12.title: Hiking-bear / commodity de-rate (-28%)
2021-11-12.body: Rare-earth and lithium names de-rated through early 2022 as the Fed-hiking bear and China lockdowns hit commodity-linked equities. Speculative, high-beta materials sold off ahead of the broad market.
2021-11-12.body_zh: 随美联储加息熊市和中国封控冲击大宗相关股票，稀土和锂个股在 2022 年初去估值。投机性、高贝塔的材料板块领先大盘抛售。
drivers_zh: 美联储加息熊市冲击大宗股票
中国封控抑制材料需求

2022-01-27.title: Commodity-supercycle bounce (+46%)
2022-01-27.body: Rallied with the 2022 commodity/inflation spike — the Russia-Ukraine war and supply fears lifted the whole materials complex through early 2023. Lithium prices in particular ran hot.
drivers: Lithium price spike on EV demand
2022-01-27.body_zh: 随 2022 年大宗/通胀飙升上涨——俄乌战争和供应担忧抬升了整个材料群组至 2023 年初。锂价尤其火热。
drivers_zh: 俄乌供应冲击对材料的买盘
EV 需求推动锂价飙升

2023-02-02.title: Lithium/rare-earth price collapse (-39%)
2023-02-02.body: A long, brutal bear as the 2022 commodity spike fully unwound — lithium prices crashed on oversupply and slowing EV growth, dragging the whole basket down for a full year into the February-2024 low.
2023-02-02.body_zh: 一段漫长残酷的熊市，2022 年大宗飙升彻底回吐——锂价因供过于求和 EV 增长放缓而崩盘，把整个篮子拖累整整一年至 2024 年 2 月低点。
drivers_zh: 锂供过于求与价格崩盘
大宗超级周期回吐/去通胀

2024-02-20.title: The policy-driven moonshot (+715%)
2024-02-20.body: The defining leg — a staggering +715% over 20 months. As China tightened rare-earth export controls and the US/allied response crystallized (culminating in the 2025 Pentagon stake in MP Materials, the $110/kg NdPr price floor and magnet offtake), the ex-China supply chain re-rated from value trap to strategic must-own. Government backing turned a commodity story into a national-security story, and the stocks gapped accordingly into an October-2025 top.
drivers: China tightens rare-earth export controls (escalating into the strict 2025 regime)
US/allied ex-China supply policy (Pentagon stake in MP, $110/kg NdPr floor, 10-yr magnet offtake)
Rare earths re-rated as a national-security imperative
Speculative momentum chase into a strategic theme
2024-02-20.body_zh: 决定性的一段——20 个月内惊人的 +715%。随中国收紧稀土出口管制、美国/盟友的回应成型（在 2025 年五角大楼入股 MP Materials、110 美元/公斤镨钕价格下限和磁体包销中达到顶点），去中国化供应链从价值陷阱重估为战略必持。政府背书把大宗故事变成国家安全故事，股票相应跳涨至 2025 年 10 月高点。
drivers_zh: 中国收紧稀土出口管制（升级为严格的 2025 年体制）
美国/盟友去中国化供应政策（五角大楼入股 MP、110 美元/公斤镨钕下限、10 年磁体包销）
稀土被重估为国家安全要务
投机动量追逐战略主题

2025-10-14.title: Parabolic-top flush (-43%)
2025-10-14.body: A sharp -43% reset off the October-2025 high — a parabolic +715% run does not unwind gently. Profit-taking and a broad late-2025 risk wobble flushed the most-extended theme on the board.
drivers: High-beta de-risk of an over-extended theme
2025-10-14.body_zh: 从 2025 年 10 月高点出发的急剧 -43% 重置——一段抛物线 +715% 行情不会温和地回吐。获利了结和 2025 年底的大盘风险动摇冲刷了面板上最延伸的主题。
drivers_zh: 抛物线 +715% 行情后的获利了结
过度延伸主题的高贝塔去风险

2025-11-06.title: Policy-escalation rip (+80%)
2025-11-06.body: Snapped back +80% into late January 2026 as trade-war escalation re-ignited the supply-security bid — every fresh export-control headline is, paradoxically, bullish for the ex-China names that benefit from scarcity.
drivers: Trade-war / export-control re-escalation re-ignites the bid
High-beta upside torque off the October flush
2025-11-06.body_zh: 弹回 +80% 至 2026 年 1 月底，因贸易战升级重新点燃供应安全买盘——每一条新的出口管制头条，悖论地，对受益于稀缺的去中国化个股是利好。
drivers_zh: 贸易战/出口管制再升级重新点燃买盘
从 10 月冲刷出发的高贝塔上行扭矩

2026-01-23.title: De-escalation pullback (-30%)
2026-01-23.body: Gave back -30% into late March as the trade war cooled (a partial export-control suspension was negotiated, running to Nov-10-2026). Easing tensions remove the scarcity premium — the inverse of the escalation rip.
2026-01-23.body_zh: 随贸易战降温（谈成部分出口管制暂停，延续至 2026 年 11 月 10 日），回吐 -30% 至 3 月底。紧张缓和移除了稀缺溢价——升级暴涨的反面。
drivers_zh: 谈成部分出口管制暂停（至 2026 年 11 月）
2026 年强势美元对大宗的逆风

2026-03-30.title: Re-escalation bounce (+61%)
2026-03-30.body: Another +61% whip higher into early May as supply-security headlines flared again. The pattern is now unmistakable: this basket is an option on US-China trade tension, ripping on escalation and fading on detente.
2026-03-30.body_zh: 随供应安全头条再度爆发，又一次 +61% 鞭打走高至 5 月初。模式现已明白无误：该篮子是中美贸易紧张的期权，升级则暴涨，缓和则消退。
drivers_zh: 供应安全/贸易紧张头条重燃

2026-05-06.title: Current de-risk to the lows (-32%)
2026-05-06.body: The current selloff — down -32% to pos 1.6, the floor of its range, tagged 'Bottoming'. The June-2026 escalation (China sanctioning MP Materials/USA Rare Earth directly and barring 46 US defense/industrial firms) is a double-edged headline: bullish for the long-run scarcity thesis, but it landed amid a strong-dollar, sticky-CPI risk-off tape that flushed the high-beta complex. With the Pentagon backstop ($110/kg floor, $725M metallization loan) under the leaders, this looks like a policy-supported washout rather than a structural break.
drivers: June-2026 China sanctions on MP/USA Rare Earth + 46 US-firm procurement ban
Strong-dollar / sticky-CPI risk-off flushes high-beta materials
Pentagon backstop ($110/kg floor, $725M metallization loan) under the leaders
Bottoming at the floor of its range (pos 1.6) on policy-supported washout
2026-05-06.body_zh: 当前的抛售——下跌 -32% 至 pos 1.6，区间底部，标记为'筑底'。2026 年 6 月的升级（中国直接制裁 MP Materials/USA Rare Earth 并排除 46 家美国国防/工业企业）是一条双刃头条：对长期稀缺逻辑利好，但它落在强势美元、粘性 CPI 的避险行情中，冲刷了高贝塔群组。在五角大楼后盾（110 美元/公斤下限、7.25 亿美元金属化贷款）支撑龙头之下，这看起来像政策支持的洗盘，而非结构性断裂。
drivers_zh: 2026 年 6 月中国制裁 MP/USA Rare Earth+46 家美国企业采购禁令
强势美元/粘性 CPI 避险冲刷高贝塔材料
五角大楼后盾（110 美元/公斤下限、7.25 亿美元金属化贷款）支撑龙头
在区间底部（pos 1.6）于政策支持的洗盘中筑底

insurance.now: Insurance & brokers (KIE) keep grinding higher in a low-drama uptrend — the quietest compounder in Financials. The whole story since mid-2022 is one long rally: a hard property/casualty pricing cycle (rate-on-line still firm), and a rate tailwind that turned every dollar of insurance float into real investment income once the Fed left policy restrictive. Brokers (Marsh, Aon, Gallagher) compound fees regardless of the rate path; P&C names (Progressive, Chubb, Travelers) earn the underwriting margin. The basket cooled off its early-2025 peak but never broke — at pos 36.5 with middling RS (#23), it's a hold-and-collect, not a chase. The 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock and a Fed back in hiking bias are mild positives here (more investment income, no credit blow-up), which is exactly why this group is where you hide when the AI trade wobbles.
insurance.now_zh: 保险与经纪（KIE）在低波动上行趋势中继续稳步走高——金融板块中最安静的复利机器。自2022年中以来就是一段长牛：财产险（P&C）定价处于硬周期（rate-on-line 仍坚挺），加上利率顺风——美联储维持限制性政策后，每一美元保险浮存金都转化为真实的投资收益。经纪商（Marsh、Aon、Gallagher）无论利率如何都靠手续费复利增长；P&C 巨头（Progressive、Chubb、Travelers）赚承保利润。该篮子从2025年初高点回落但从未破位——pos 36.5、RS 居中（第23位），属于持有收息、而非追涨的标的。2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击叠加美联储重回加息倾向，对本组温和利好（投资收益更多、无信用爆雷），这正是 AI 交易动摇时资金避险的去处。

2022-04-20.title: 2022 rate-shock dip (−16%)
2022-04-20.body: Insurance sold off with the broad 2022 Fed-hiking bear, but far more shallowly than tech — a −16% drawdown versus 30%+ in growth. Higher discount rates hit every equity, yet for insurers the same rising rates were a long-term gift: bond reinvestment yields were climbing, and a hard P&C pricing cycle was already underway after years of catastrophe losses. This was a macro drawdown, not a business-model crack.
2022-04-20.body_zh: 保险随2022年美联储加息熊市回调，但跌幅远浅于科技——回撤仅约−16%，而成长股跌逾30%。更高的贴现率压制所有股票，但对保险公司而言，同样的利率上行是长期礼物：债券再投资收益率正在攀升，且在多年巨灾损失之后，P&C 硬定价周期已经启动。这是宏观回撤，而非商业模式破裂。
drivers: Fed hiking cycle compressed all equity multiples
Hard P&C pricing cycle already lifting rate-on-line
Rising reinvestment yields = future float income
Shallow drawdown vs growth = defensive character
drivers_zh: 美联储加息周期压缩全市场估值
P&C 硬定价周期已在抬升 rate-on-line
再投资收益率上升＝未来浮存金收益
回撤远浅于成长股＝防御属性

2022-06-16.title: The quiet +96% compounder (Jun '22 → Apr '25)
2022-06-16.body: From the June 2022 low, insurance rallied ~96% in an almost straight line that ignored every macro storm: the SVB regional-bank crisis (Mar 2023), the 2024 Fed cuts and election, even the April 2025 tariff crash. The engine is structural — a multi-year hard pricing cycle (insurers raising premiums faster than claims inflation) layered on top of a rate tailwind that made insurance float genuinely profitable for the first time in a decade. Brokers compounded fees; P&C names compounded underwriting margin. This is the textbook steady compounder leg — low volatility, high quality, the place capital rotates to when the speculative trade gets scary. The leg's end near April 2025 marks where the basket finally cooled off its peak, not where the thesis broke.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 自2022年6月低点起，保险近乎直线上涨约96%，无视一切宏观风暴：硅谷银行（SVB）区域银行危机（2023年3月）、2024年美联储降息与大选、乃至2025年4月关税崩盘。引擎是结构性的——多年期硬定价周期（保险公司提价快于理赔通胀）叠加利率顺风，使保险浮存金十年来首次真正盈利。经纪商靠手续费复利，P&C 巨头靠承保利润复利。这是教科书式的稳健复利行情——低波动、高质量，正是投机交易令人恐惧时资金轮动的去处。该行情在2025年4月附近见顶，标志篮子从高点回落，而非论点破裂。
drivers: Multi-year hard P&C pricing cycle (premiums > claims inflation)
Float investment income turned real with higher rates
Shrugged off SVB crisis, tariff crash, election volatility
Brokers compound fees independent of rate path
drivers_zh: 多年期 P&C 硬定价周期（保费涨幅＞理赔通胀）
高利率使浮存金投资收益真正兑现
无视 SVB 危机、关税崩盘、大选波动
经纪商手续费复利、独立于利率路径

payments_fintech.now: Payments & fintech (proxied by XLF) is at Prime entry — pos 15.1, washed out near the bottom of its range after a sharp ~29% drawdown from the August 2025 peak into early 2026. This is the rate-sensitive, consumer-spend-levered corner of Financials: the networks (Visa, Mastercard) are toll-roads on transaction volume, while the disruptors (PayPal, Block/Square) trade like long-duration growth and get whipsawed by every move in rates and recession odds. The 2026 Iran/Hormuz oil shock (CPI 4.2%) and a Fed back in hiking bias are the proximate weight — higher rates compress fintech multiples and a squeezed consumer threatens spend volume. But the low absolute position and the strong V/MA secular volume story are why this scores as a setup, not a sell. The names that survive on real free cash flow (the networks) anchor the basket; the speculative fintech tail is the risk.
payments_fintech.now_zh: 支付与金融科技（以 XLF 代理）处于黄金入场——pos 15.1，自2025年8月高点经历约−29%的急跌至2026年初后，已在区间底部附近被洗盘。这是金融板块中对利率敏感、与消费支出高度挂钩的角落：支付网络（Visa、Mastercard）是交易量上的收费公路，而颠覆者（PayPal、Block/Square）则像长久期成长股，随利率与衰退概率的每次波动剧烈摇摆。2026年伊朗/霍尔木兹石油冲击（CPI 4.2%）叠加美联储重回加息倾向，是当前压力的近因——高利率压缩金融科技估值，受挤压的消费者威胁支付量。但绝对位置偏低、加上 V/MA 强劲的长期交易量故事，正是本组被评为入场而非卖出的原因。靠真实自由现金流生存的网络巨头锚定篮子；投机性金融科技尾部才是风险所在。

2021-09-23.title: 2021-22 duration purge (−45%)
2021-09-23.body: Fintech was ground zero for the 2022 Fed-hiking bear. As the most rate-sensitive, longest-duration corner of Financials, the basket fell ~45% — the growth-at-any-price fintech cohort (PayPal off its pandemic-stimulus highs, Block, Affirm) got obliterated as discount rates rose and the work-from-home spend bubble deflated. Even the durable networks (V/MA) de-rated. This leg is the classic warning that fintech bundles two very different things: toll-road networks and speculative growth.
2021-09-23.body_zh: 金融科技是2022年美联储加息熊市的震中。作为金融板块中对利率最敏感、久期最长的角落，篮子下跌约45%——不计价格的成长型金融科技群（PayPal 从疫情刺激高点滑落、Block、Affirm）随贴现率上升、居家办公支付泡沫消退而被摧毁。即便耐用的网络巨头（V/MA）也估值下修。这段行情是经典警示：所谓金融科技捆绑了两类截然不同的东西——收费公路网络与投机成长。
drivers: Highest rate-sensitivity in Financials → multiple compression
drivers_zh: 金融板块中利率敏感度最高→估值压缩
疫情刺激支付泡沫消退
投机性金融科技（PYPL/SQ/AFRM）跌幅最深
即便耐用网络（V/MA）也估值下修

2022-03-14.title: Oversold relief bounce (+27%)
2022-03-14.body: A sharp two-week snapback from the March 2022 low as the market priced the first Fed hike as 'known' and bombed-out long-duration growth got a reflex bounce. The high-beta fintech disruptors led the rip, but it was a counter-trend move inside the larger 2022 bear, not a turn.
2022-03-14.body_zh: 自2022年3月低点起为期两周的急速回升，市场把首次美联储加息视为已知，被打入谷底的长久期成长迎来反射性反弹。高 beta 金融科技颠覆者领涨，但这是更大2022年熊市中的逆势波动，而非转折。
drivers: Reflex bounce in bombed-out long-duration growth
drivers_zh: 首次美联储加息被视为已知
被打入谷底的长久期成长反射性反弹
高 beta 金融科技颠覆者领涨

2022-03-29.title: Hawkish-repricing leg down (−32%)
2022-03-29.body: The relief bounce reversed hard into May 2022 as the Fed signaled a faster, larger hiking path and recession fear built. Rate-sensitive fintech was hit worst — every upward revision in the terminal-rate path compressed the long-duration multiples again. The networks held up far better than the speculative tail.
2022-03-29.body_zh: 随美联储释放更快、更大的加息路径信号、衰退担忧累积，喘息反弹急转直下至2022年5月。对利率敏感的金融科技受创最重——终端利率路径的每次上修都再次压缩长久期估值。网络巨头远比投机尾部抗跌。
drivers: Networks held up better than speculative tail
drivers_zh: 美联储释放更快/更大加息路径信号
终端利率上修再次压缩长久期估值
网络巨头比投机尾部抗跌

2022-05-11.title: Short squeeze bounce (+24%)
2022-05-11.body: A brief two-week bounce off the May 2022 low — an oversold, short-covering rally in a deeply hated group. No fundamental catalyst; it fizzled within weeks as the broad market resumed its slide toward the mid-2022 low.
2022-05-11.body_zh: 自2022年5月低点起为期两周的短暂反弹——深度被嫌弃组别中的超卖、空头回补行情。无基本面催化剂；数周内即熄火，随后大盘恢复向2022年中低点的下滑。

2022-05-27.title: Final 2022-bear leg down (−21%)
2022-05-27.body: The last leg of the first-half 2022 selloff into the mid-June low, as a hot CPI print forced the Fed into a 75bp hike and recession pricing peaked. Fintech bottomed here with the broad market before the summer relief rally.
2022-05-27.body_zh: 上半年2022年抛售的最后一段，至6月中旬低点，火热的 CPI 数据迫使美联储加息75个基点、衰退定价见顶。金融科技在此随大盘见底，随后迎来夏季喘息反弹。
drivers: Hot CPI forced a 75bp Fed hike
Bottomed with the broad market at mid-June low
Set up the summer relief rally
drivers_zh: 火热 CPI 迫使美联储加息75个基点
随大盘于6月中旬低点见底

2022-06-16.title: Summer relief rally (+34%)
2022-06-16.body: A strong +34% summer rally into mid-August 2022 on hopes that inflation had peaked and the Fed might pivot. Long-duration fintech, the most beaten-down cohort, led the bounce — but it was a classic bear-market rally that reversed once Jackson Hole reaffirmed the hawkish stance.
2022-06-16.body_zh: 随通胀见顶、美联储或将转向的预期，出现强劲的+34%夏季反弹至2022年8月中旬。跌得最惨的长久期金融科技领涨——但这是经典的熊市反弹，在杰克逊霍尔重申鹰派立场后即反转。
drivers: Hopes inflation had peaked / Fed pivot
Reversed after Jackson Hole reaffirmed hawkishness
drivers_zh: 通胀见顶/美联储转向预期
跌得最惨的长久期金融科技领涨
杰克逊霍尔重申鹰派后反转

2022-08-16.title: Jackson Hole give-back (−24%)
2022-08-16.body: The summer rally unwound into November 2022 after Jackson Hole crushed pivot hopes and rates pushed to new cycle highs. Rate-sensitive fintech gave back most of the bounce — the basket made a higher low here as the broad market neared its October 2022 bottom.
2022-08-16.body_zh: 夏季反弹在杰克逊霍尔粉碎转向预期、利率推升至新周期高点后回吐至2022年11月。对利率敏感的金融科技回吐大部分涨幅——篮子在此筑出更高的低点，恰逢大盘逼近2022年10月底部。
drivers: Rates pushed to new cycle highs
Rate-sensitive fintech gave back the bounce
Higher low as broad market neared October bottom
drivers_zh: 杰克逊霍尔粉碎转向预期
利率推升至新周期高点
对利率敏感的金融科技回吐反弹
大盘逼近10月底部时筑更高低点

2022-11-09.title: First bounce off the lows (+32%)
2022-11-09.body: A sharp recovery as the market began pricing peak-rate hopes and the genAI rally took hold in early 2023. The networks led — Visa and Mastercard kept posting double-digit volume growth regardless of macro — while the bombed-out fintech disruptors got an oversold bounce. The move stalled by February 2023, just before the SVB regional-bank crisis re-introduced fear into anything Financials-coded.
2022-11-09.body_zh: 随市场开始定价利率见顶预期、2023年初生成式 AI 行情启动，出现急速反弹。网络巨头领涨——无论宏观如何，Visa 与 Mastercard 持续录得两位数交易量增长——同时被打入谷底的金融科技颠覆者迎来超卖反弹。该行情在2023年2月停滞，恰在 SVB 区域银行危机给一切带金融标签的资产重新注入恐惧之前。
drivers: Network volume growth stayed double-digit through macro
Oversold bounce in bombed-out fintech disruptors
Stalled into the Feb-2023 SVB scare
drivers_zh: 利率见顶预期提振长久期成长
网络交易量增长全程保持两位数
被打入谷底的金融科技颠覆者超卖反弹
行情停滞于2023年2月 SVB 恐慌前夕

2023-02-02.title: SVB-scare pullback (−22%)
2023-02-02.body: A −22% drop into May 2023 as the SVB regional-bank crisis hit anything Financials-coded and a renewed hawkish-Fed scare lifted rates. Payments got caught in the cross-asset de-risking even though the networks had no banking-deposit exposure — guilt by sector association. The basket bottomed in early May with the regional-bank low.
2023-02-02.body_zh: 回落−22%至2023年5月，SVB 区域银行危机冲击一切带金融标签的资产、加上美联储鹰派恐慌重燃推升利率。支付被卷入跨资产去风险，尽管网络巨头并无银行存款敞口——板块关联的连坐。篮子于5月初随区域银行低点见底。
drivers: Guilt by sector association (networks have no deposit risk)
Bottomed early May with regional-bank low
drivers_zh: SVB 危机冲击一切带金融标签资产
美联储鹰派恐慌重燃推升利率
板块关联的连坐（网络无存款风险）

2023-05-02.title: Post-SVB recovery rally (+41%)
2023-05-02.body: A strong +41% rebound into August 2023 as the SVB panic faded, the Fed neared the end of its hiking cycle, and the early genAI rally broadened. The durable networks led on resilient consumer spend while the fintech disruptors caught the risk-on tailwind. A real recovery leg, not just a bounce.
2023-05-02.body_zh: 强劲反弹+41%至2023年8月，SVB 恐慌消退、美联储接近加息周期尾声、早期生成式 AI 行情扩散。耐用的网络巨头凭借坚韧的消费支出领涨，金融科技颠覆者抓住风险偏好顺风。这是真正的复苏行情，而非仅是反弹。
drivers: SVB panic faded; Fed near end of hiking cycle
Durable networks led on resilient consumer spend
Real recovery leg, not just a bounce
drivers_zh: SVB 恐慌消退；美联储接近加息尾声
早期生成式 AI 行情扩散风险偏好
耐用网络凭坚韧消费支出领涨
真正的复苏行情、非仅反弹

2023-08-01.title: Higher-for-longer dip (−23%)
2023-08-01.body: A −23% pullback into late October 2023 as the 10-year yield spiked toward 5% on a 'higher-for-longer' Fed and recession worries resurfaced. Rate-sensitive fintech sold off with all long-duration assets — but this October 2023 low became the launchpad for the +117% bull run that followed.
2023-08-01.body_zh: 回调−23%至2023年10月底，10年期收益率在美联储更高更久立场下飙向5%、衰退担忧再起。对利率敏感的金融科技随所有长久期资产抛售——但这个2023年10月低点成为随后+117%牛市的发射台。
drivers: Rate-sensitive fintech sold with long-duration assets
Oct-2023 low became launchpad for the +117% run
drivers_zh: 10年期收益率在更高更久立场下飙向5%
对利率敏感金融科技随长久期资产抛售

2023-10-27.title: The +117% post-SVB-to-peak bull run
2023-10-27.body: The big leg: from the October 2023 low, payments & fintech more than doubled (+117%) into February 2025. Falling-rate expectations, a resilient US consumer, and the September 2024 Fed cuts re-rated the long-duration fintech names, while the networks compounded steadily on cross-border travel and ecommerce volume. The November 2024 election added a deregulation/M&A tailwind to the whole financial complex.
